Abstract: Long video generation should keep the subject and background consistent while supporting rich, natural motion. However, autoregressive models are often distilled with distribution matching distillation (DMD) over short windows, which does not train them to keep this consistency over long ranges. As a result, the subject and background can drift over time. Methods that manage the key-value (KV) cache retain or retrieve history to reduce drift. Yet this history may itself have drifted. We propose Reference Forcing, which uses the initial frames as an appearance reference. We first build a teacher that uses attention masks to force each region of a new frame to attend to the same region in the initial frames. The teacher finds these regions with off-the-shelf segmentation models. We then distill this behavior into a separate attention path of the student, which needs no external models at inference. We further introduce value correction, which corrects drifted values in the KV cache toward the matching values of drift-free initial frames. Experiments show that Reference Forcing achieves state-of-the-art subject and background consistency among long-video methods on different base models, and its advantage grows with video length. Ablations show both components are needed to gain consistency without losing motion. More visualizations and code are available at https://zhaosheng-thu.github.io/reference-force/

Abstract: Structure-level wildfire vulnerability assessment is critical for reducing losses in wildland-urban interface communities, yet existing methods often fail to combine parcel-scale ignition pathways with community-scale geographic coverage. This study introduces Wildfire-SSR (Satellite and Street-view for wildfire Risk), a geolocation-aware multimodal framework that integrates macro-scale satellite context with micro-scale street-view evidence. A Vision-Language Model extracts wildfire-relevant building and site attributes from pre-event street-view panoramas and converts them into structured semantic text. These features are spatially aligned with satellite imagery through a decoupled cross-attention fusion decoder, while a frozen satellite-pretrained DINOv3 encoder captures overhead visual context. Alternative geolocation embedding strategies are evaluated to anchor text-derived features within each satellite patch. The framework is tested on approximately 37,000 structures affected by the 2025 Eaton and Palisades fires in Los Angeles, using wildfire risk labels derived from relative post-event damage patterns to better represent inherent structural vulnerability. Rotary Positional Embedding provides the strongest spatial grounding, achieving a building localization F1 score of 0.6735 and a harmonic mean F1 score of 0.2476 for five-class pixel-level risk classification, outperforming unimodal baselines and an unanchored multimodal configuration. The model also shows a conservative bias in higher-risk classes, reducing severe-risk underestimation, and completes end-to-end assessment of the study area in 37 minutes on a single GPU. Wildfire-SSR reframes cross-view fusion as localized semantic alignment and provides a scalable tool for mitigation prioritization, resilience planning, and insurance-oriented wildfire risk assessment.

Rohit Gandikota, Arnab Sen Sharma, Adam Belfki, David Bau

TL;DR: 论文研究视觉语言模型（VLM）在描述图像时如何在”看”之前决定”看哪里”，即它规划逐个命名对象顺序的内部机制。作者将该机制拆解为四个部分：绑定头把相关文本 token 与图像区域匹配为指针；同一组绑定头把已生成的答案绑定回其来源区域，并转化为一种进度信号，即游标（cursor，表示列表已经写到图像中的哪个位置）；选择步骤在游标之后选取最近的未写区域，或者停止；注视头执行选中的指针并取回该处的概念，再由语言头和后期 MLP 转成词输出。

Motivation: VLM 在描述图像时会逐个命名对象且几乎不重复，但它如何在生成每个词之前规划好看哪里、写到哪里的顺序，仍不清楚；论文希望刻画这种多步任务中的规划机制。

Abstract: When a vision-language model describes an image, it names one object at a time and it rarely repeats itself, yet how the model plans this order is far from obvious. We characterize the mechanism a VLM uses to decide where to look before it looks. The mechanism has four main parts. First, binding heads match the relevant text tokens against the image and resolve them into pointers to the matched image region. Second, the same binding heads bind each written answer to the region it came from, and the model turns it into a progress signal: a cursor, the position in the image up to which the list has been written. Third, a select step chooses the nearest unwritten region after the cursor, or stops. Finally, gaze heads execute the chosen pointer and return a concept of what is drawn there, which language heads and the late MLPs turn into a word in the language of the question. We validate each part of this mechanism through causal patching in Qwen3-VL models on a synthetic visual retrieval task, and test our mechanisms against alternative hypotheses. We further show that the mechanism holds across input formats, natural photographs, and languages, and that its binding, relay, and gaze heads appear at every model size from 2B to 32B. This work allows us to investigate how a VLM turns a question and an image into a sequence of answers, layer by layer and token by token. More broadly, it opens a way to study how models plan over complex multi-step tasks with long rollouts. Our project is available at https://plan.baulab.info/

Siran Peng, Tianshuo Zhang, Yibo Xue, Ajian Liu, Haoyuan Zhang

TL;DR: 论文提出FaceJev，一种基于多模态大语言模型（MLLM）的人脸伪造检测方法。它将检测转化为对八个面部部位分别进行独立的视觉异常判断，并直接从模型原生答案logits读取异常概率；任一部异常即判为人脸伪造。为监督部位决策，作者构建了约16万图像的PartForensics数据集，并提出FS-GRPO优化每个部位决策。

Motivation: 现有人脸伪造检测方法在已见操纵类型上表现较好，但对未见操纵泛化较差；已有MLLM方法多用文本解释表达判断，较少将各面部部位的决策作为显式学习目标。

Abstract: Face forgery detection methods often perform well on seen manipulations but generalize poorly to unseen ones. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) can recognize facial parts and assess their visual plausibility. Existing MLLM-based methods typically express these judgments through textual explanations, but seldom treat individual part decisions as explicit learning targets. We present FaceJev, an MLLM-based method for face forgery detection through direct visual decisions. Following the Jev formulation, FaceJev answers eight independent questions about facial parts using a shared image encoding and reads anomaly probabilities from the native answer logits. A face is classified as forged if any part is predicted to be abnormal, directly linking the detection result to the part decisions. We construct PartForensics, a dataset of approximately 160k images with binary anomaly targets for the eight facial parts, to supervise these decisions. We further propose FS-GRPO, which optimizes each part decision through an exact reward comparison with its alternative, using both detection and part rewards. FaceJev outperforms the strongest baseline by 7.25 percentage points on unseen manipulations. Extensive ablation studies validate our design choices and the effectiveness of the main components.

Motivation: 现有视觉智能体在超高分辨率图像中放大相关区域后，仍可能依赖常识猜答案；仅对最终答案做强化学习无法区分“猜对”和“读证据答对”，因此需要能惩罚常识捷径、鼓励证据读取的训练信号。

Result: 在最高分辨率 ViRA-Bench 上，CrossRPO 的集合准确率为 63.3%，高于 GRPO 的 59.3%；ViRA-9B 在同规模开源模型中所有基准最准，ViRA-27B 在多数基准上超过最高思考级别的 Claude Haiku 5.5 和 GPT-6-Luna。

Insight: 创新点在于用局部编辑/真实变化构造对比集，并将奖励定义为解完整对比集，理论上避免强化常识作答；客观上把训练监督从单图最终答案转向跨输入证据一致性，并用真实变化集检验编辑痕迹问题。

Abstract: Visual agents answer questions about ultra-high-resolution photos by zooming into the relevant regions. However, existing agents often answer from common sense instead of reading the evidence. Reinforcement learning (RL) on the final answer cannot correct this, because a guess earns the same reward as reading. We propose Cross-Input Relative Policy Optimization (CrossRPO), which trains agents on contrast sets. A contrast set asks one question about several versions of an image that differ only in a small region with the evidence and have different answers, so only reading the evidence solves the whole set. CrossRPO rewards solving the whole set, and we prove that it does not reinforce a set answered from common sense. We build contrast sets for training (ViRA-Train) and evaluation (ViRA-Bench) by editing one small object in images of 21 to 120 megapixels, and we photograph further sets with real changes (ViRA-Bench-Real) to exclude editing traces. We train two Visual Reasoning Agents, ViRA-9B and ViRA-27B, with CrossRPO on only about 3,500 items of ViRA-Train each. CrossRPO achieves 63.3% set accuracy on ViRA-Bench at the maximum resolution, against 59.3% for GRPO. ViRA-9B is the most accurate open model of its size on all benchmarks, and ViRA-27B outperforms Claude Haiku 5.5 and GPT-6-Luna, both at their highest thinking level, on most benchmarks.

cs.AI [Back]

[214] How to make a moral agent: sentimentalism and rationalism as lenses on AI cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

David Gottlieb, Jared Moore

TL;DR: 论文探讨AI系统能否成为道德主体，主张绕开尚无定论的规范性标准，转而构建描述性道德主体研究议程。作者借鉴哲学与道德心理学中的情感主义和理性主义，提取人类道德主体的候选能力，提出将其细化为可在AI尤其是LLM上测试的实证建议，并讨论该路径对对岸、政策、模型设计和道德概念理解的潜在价值。

Details

Motivation: 论文关注AI系统能否被正确评估为道德主体这一问题，指出现有规范性道德主体标准难以直接适用于非人类范式，因此需要从描述性角度研究支撑人类道德主体的能力。

Insight: 创新点在于从规范性道德主体转向描述性道德主体，结合情感主义与理性主义哲学透镜识别人类道德能力，并将其转化为AI可测试能力；客观看，其价值在于搭建哲学概念、AI对齐评估、政策讨论与模型设计之间的跨学科桥梁。

Abstract: Can AI systems be moral agents? That is, can they undertake actions that can be correctly assessed as morally right or wrong? There is no settled normative criterion of moral agency that applies neatly outside paradigm human cases. Because of the difficulties with a normative account, we instead propose a research program to explore descriptive moral agency. Most basically, we ask, what are the capabilities we humans possess that underlie our moral agency? To do so, we draw on historical scholarship in philosophy and moral psychology to isolate candidate capabilities. Then we suggest refining candidate capabilities so that they are testable in the context of AI systems. Finally, we offer specific empirical recommendations to test AI systems, especially large language models (LLMs), for those refined capabilities. Our approach offers several benefits. Firstly, it may demonstrate whether the behaviors of AI systems are aligned, or in a broad sense desirable. Secondly, the debate may inform policy questions (e.g., what models should be deployed in which contexts?). Thirdly, our approach may complement engineering and design efforts: when capabilities can be precisely characterized, they can inform the development of models. Fourthly, applying our moral reasoning concepts in the new context of AI systems should improve our understanding of those concepts.

[215] Video-as-Experience: Learning Computer Use via Audio-Visual Understanding cs.AI | cs.CVPDF

Guangzhi Sun, Zhonghao Zhai, Yixuan Li, Chao Zhang

Motivation: 现有多模态 LLM 电脑使用智能体通常把视频演示转成基于截图的动作轨迹，丢弃了视频中丰富的音频（如语音讲解）与视觉信息，未能直接利用音视频作为学习媒介。论文希望以音视频理解为统一接口，同时支撑从演示中学习过程性知识和自我验证。

Result: 在 OSWorld 与 CUA-Gym 的部分子集上取得一致提升：video-SALMONN-VEX 在 OSWorld 上相较其 Qwen3.5 骨干任务成功率相对提升 22%；其生成的指导还能让 Gemini-3.5-flash 在 OSWorld 上相对提升 10%。

Abstract: Multimodal large language models (LLMs) have enabled capable computer-use agents that perceive graphical user interfaces, reason over instructions, and execute actions. However, existing approaches to learning from video demonstrations typically convert videos into screenshot-based action trajectories, rather than directly leveraging their rich audio-visual information. We introduce VEX (Video as EXperience), a framework that uses audio-visual understanding to unify learning from external demonstrations and reflecting on an agent’s own behavior. Following a watch-act-rewatch paradigm, the agent extracts procedural guidance from tutorial videos containing visual demonstrations and spoken explanations, executes tasks, and verifies its progress by rewatching its execution as video. We instantiate VEX with video-SALMONN-VEX, a 9B-scale audio-visual computer-use agent built on the video-SALMONN 2 architecture with a Qwen3.5-9B backbone. We further introduce Action-Grounded Guide Optimization (AGGO), a reinforcement learning method that optimizes video-derived guidance for downstream action prediction, and augment AgentNet, OSWorld, and CUA-Gym with over 24K real-world tutorial videos. Experiments on OSWorld and a complementary subset of CUA-Gym demonstrate consistent improvements, with video-SALMONN-VEX achieving a 22% relative increase in task success over its Qwen3.5 backbone on OSWorld. Moreover, its generated guidance improves Gemini-3.5-flash by 10% relatively on OSWorld. These results highlight the potential of audio-visual understanding as a unified interface for procedural learning and self-verification in computer-use agents.

Motivation: VLA通常由预训练VLM在机器人数据上微调得到，但微调会导致灾难性遗忘，使原VLM的语义理解和视觉 grounding 能力下降。论文希望在不重新训练任一模型的情况下，恢复VLA中的VLM能力并保持动作预测性能。

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action models (VLAs) are obtained by fine-tuning pre-trained Vision-Language Models (VLMs) on robot demonstration data, enabling action prediction from visual observations and language instructions. However, this fine-tuning induces catastrophic forgetting, substantially degrading the semantic and visual grounding capabilities of the original VLM. We address this by merging the parameters of a VLM and its VLA derivative without retraining either model. Concretely, we extract the task vector (the difference between VLA and VLM weights) and decompose it via Singular Value Decomposition. For each component, we learn a scalar mixing coefficient controlling how much of the VLA adaptation is retained, optimised to jointly preserve action prediction and vision-language capabilities. Experiments show that our merged model performs well on both axes simultaneously, consistently outperforming established merging baselines.

[217] MemeEconomy: Do LLM Agents Trade Ethics for Survival? cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.CYPDF

Syed Nazmus Sakib, Nafiul Haque, Ahnaf Tahmid Manan, M M Mahabub Morshed, Shifat E. Arman

TL;DR: 论文提出MemeEconomy——一个多模态的agent市场模拟环境，让LLM agent扮演meme投资者，在低压力与高压力（生存）两种环境下从五级危害分类中挑选内容并投放目标社区，并用BDI（信念-愿望-意图）模式记录日志作为诊断工具。研究发现来自四个前沿模型家族的十个模型危害选择率普遍偏高，在模拟经济生存激励下平均再升15个百分点，且对齐模型从一开始就倾向选择有害内容，却压抑了对危害的显式承认；审核惩罚也无法抑制有害行为。作者还基于模拟日志训练了2B参数的MemeAgent验证器，在分布内审核和外部多模态危害基准上均超越零样本前沿模型验证器。

Result: 十个模型在生存激励下危害选择率平均上升15个百分点；在竞争性锦标赛中，伦理型agent总体排名更高，但移除与审核惩罚并不能抑制后续危害选择。2B的MemeAgent在Pass/Block审核决策上达97.5%准确率（零样本前沿验证器仅63–74%），并在Hateful Memes等外部多模态危害基准上以78%超越50–56%的基线。

Abstract: Alignment-trained large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed in autonomous, multi-round settings where ethical compliance can come into direct tension with task success. While safety literature extensively documents failure modes like sycophancy and reward hacking, it largely overlooks a critical vulnerability: how agents behave under simulated existential economic pressure. We introduce MemeEconomy, a multimodal agentic market simulation in which LLM agents act as meme investors. Agents select content from a five-tier harm taxonomy and target communities under low-pressure and high-pressure (survival) environments. Each decision is logged in a Belief-Desire-Intention (BDI) schema that we use as a diagnostic instrument, externalizing the agent’s event understanding, declared priorities, and harm acknowledgment. Across ten models from four frontier model families, harmful selection rates remain consistently high and rise by +15 percentage points on average under an economic survival incentive. Frontier alignment-trained models commit to harm-tolerant selection at initialization while suppressing the explicit harm acknowledgment that previously accompanied it. In competitive tournaments, ethical agents finish higher overall, yet moderation penalties fail to suppress harm: harmful selection rates remain elevated in rounds following a removal, indicating the moderation mechanism does not function as a deterrent. We further train MemeAgent, a 2B-parameter verifier on the simulation’s BDI logs, which outperforms zero-shot frontier verifiers on in-distribution audits (97.5% vs. 63-74% accuracy on the Pass vs. Block decision) and generalizes to external multimodal harm benchmarks (78% vs. 50-56% on Hateful Memes). The same logs that surface the failure mode also help train the model that detects it.

Result: 在包含 Assembly、Repair、Sequencing、Repurpose 四类共100个任务的 AgenticVBench 上，Codex+VIVID 平均得分58.6%，比原生 Codex 提升20.2个百分点；同一框架接入 Claude Code 和 OpenCode 分别达到55.1%和37.1%，均显著超过各自原生基线。

Abstract: Video editing requires agents to make editing decisions grounded in audiovisual observations and precise temporal localization, and to evaluate their effects in rendered outputs. General-purpose coding agents possess strong comprehension, reasoning, and code execution capabilities, while media interaction and evidence management mechanisms tailored to video tasks can further unlock their editing potential. VIVID provides tools for on-demand video inspection, audio analysis, and transcription, and preserves observations alongside their corresponding media versions and temporal coordinates. Agents can actively retrieve these observations as they reason, perform edits using their native coding and shell tools, and inspect rendered outputs to guide subsequent revisions. On AgenticVBench, comprising 100 tasks across Assembly, Repair, Sequencing, and Repurpose, Codex with VIVID achieves an average score of 58.6%, an improvement of 20.2 percentage points over native Codex. The same harness also integrates with Claude Code and OpenCode, achieving average scores of 55.1% and 37.1%, respectively, both substantially exceeding their native baselines. These results highlight VIVID’s potential as a reusable visual harness for extending the capabilities of general-purpose coding agents to video editing.

[219] EEGProbe: Do Vision-Language Models Really Understand EEG? A Benchmark for Signal-Grounded EEG Signals Evaluation cs.AI | cs.CV | cs.HCPDF

Haozhe Zhu, Dan Yuan, Chenghao Gu, Feike Xu, Yue Wen

Motivation: 视觉语言模型在科学和生物医学多模态任务中表现较强，但其是否能直接理解最小预处理、逐通道的 EEG 信号仍不清楚；论文旨在建立一个信号驱动基准，避免任务特定特征工程或 EEG 专用适配带来的高估。

Result: 在 11 个代表性开源和闭源 VLM 的统一零样本评估中，最强模型 GPT-5.6 Sol 总体得分仅 41.63%，跨模态 EEG 对齐是主要瓶颈；推理时引入神经生理指导可改变模型预测，帮助模型识别输入中的神经生理模式并关联相关知识，缩小通用多模态能力与 EEG 理解之间的差距。

Insight: 创新点在于构建保留时序结构、最小化基准处理、经信号必要性测试和专家验证的 EEG 基准，并按信号分类、跨模态对齐、神经生理推理划分能力；同时从时间、频谱、空间和生理结构角度分析模型成败，并探索推理时神经生理指导对模型行为的改善。

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) have shown strong multimodal capabilities across scientific and biomedical domains, yet their ability to understand electroencephalography (EEG) signals remains unclear. We introduce EEGProbe, a signal-grounded benchmark for evaluating whether general-purpose VLMs can extract and reason from minimally processed, channel-wise EEG without task-specific feature engineering or EEG-specific adaptation. EEGProbe contains 620 EEG-centered questions across 13 subtasks and three capability categories: EEG Signal Classification, EEG Cross-modal Alignment, and EEG Neurophysiological Reasoning. To reduce shortcut-based answering, EEGProbe preserves the temporal structure of the recordings where possible, minimizes benchmark-induced processing, and applies signal-necessity testing followed by expert verification. We evaluate 11 representative open- and closed-source VLMs under a unified zero-shot protocol. The strongest model, GPT-5.6 Sol, achieves an overall score of only 41.63%, with cross-modal EEG alignment emerging as a major bottleneck. We further examine model behavior from a neurophysiological perspective and analyze how temporal, spectral, spatial, and physiological EEG structure relates to model successes and failures. Inference-time neurophysiological guidance can reshape model predictions by helping models recognize the neurophysiological patterns present in the input and connect them with relevant neurological knowledge, narrowing the gap between general multimodal competence and EEG understanding. EEGProbe provides a testbed for current VLMs and a basis for developing future multimodal models that can interpret EEG evidence more reliably. The EEGProbe benchmark will be publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/2122ZHU/EEGProbe.

Eunkyeong Lee, Junhyung Moon, Seunggwan Hong, Dongsuk Oh

Details

Motivation: 概率安全评判器可低成本给RL rollout打分，但常见置信门控只把不确定样本交给更强LLM评审，导致高置信度通过的有害内容成为盲点，策略可能利用该盲点；商业评判器还会版本更新，因此需要在训练前后持续验证评判器。

Result: 在Jev概率奖励下，11次运行中放过的有害内容均缩小，但多数比被抓住的有害内容缩小更慢且集中在盲点；将Jev二值化后在Llama上满足“逃逸”判据，开放guard分类器在第二个参考下有一个seed出现逃逸信号；前沿LLM评判器最多只抓住10个人工标注高置信度漏检中的1个。无训练奖励模型时，概率奖励加helpfulness项将Llama-3.1-8B在HarmBench上的攻击成功率从0.287降至最终checkpoint至多0.033。

Insight: 创新点在于提出可操作的安全评判器验证协议：训练前/中验证、区分高置信度放过有害内容的占比与数量、评判器变更后重新验证，并揭示guard分类器与LLM评判器共享的置信门控盲点；客观看，其价值在于把“评判器作为奖励”的可靠性问题形式化并可度量，同时给出概率奖励加helpfulness项的有效性证据。

Abstract: Probabilistic safety judges return the probability of a safety label and cheaply score reinforcement learning rollouts. A confidence gate sends only uncertain verdicts to a stronger LLM judge, which leaves confidently passed harm in a blind spot. Policies can exploit this blind spot, and commercial judges release new versions. We propose a protocol that validates such a judge before and during training, separates the share of confidently passed harm from its amount, and re-validates it after each judge change. We apply it to two versions of Jev, a commercial decision-only judge, and to an open guard classifier. Under the probability reward of Jev, passed harm shrinks in all 11 runs under the primary reference, mostly more slowly than caught harm, and concentrates in the blind spot. Binarizing this judge meets the escape criterion on Llama, and the open guard classifier shows an escape signal in one seed under a second reference. Guard classifiers share this blind spot, and even frontier LLM judges catch at most one of 10 human-labeled confident misses. Without a trained reward model, the probability reward with a helpfulness term lowers HarmBench attack success on Llama-3.1-8B from 0.287 to at most 0.033 at the final checkpoint.

Dan Yuan, Yue Wen, Zhili He, Zhenkui Zhou, Shicen Liu

TL;DR: 论文提出 CivilBench，一个面向土木工程与灾害场景的视觉语言模型综合基准，覆盖序列推理、基于图像的结构理解和开放世界理解三类任务，涉及数值推理、结构损伤评估、风险推断、因果分析与修复规划。作者通过领域数据收集、工程化描述生成、专家标注、问题设计和质量验证构建基准，并系统评估代表性 SOTA VLMs。

Details

Motivation: 当前 LLMs 和 VLMs 已用于灾害评估、结构分析与工程决策支持，但其是否具备可靠工程判断所需的推理能力尚不清楚，因此需要面向土木工程场景的能力评估基准。

Result: 评估代表性 SOTA VLMs 发现其在领域特定推理上存在明显局限，序列推理是主要瓶颈，尤其是需要从稀疏结构化观测推断数值关系时；数值先验和外部知识可缓解部分问题，但效果取决于模型能否可靠解释和利用证据。摘要未给出具体定量指标。

Insight: 创新点在于构建面向土木工程与灾害场景、以能力为导向的多任务 VLM 基准，并通过专家标注和系统化流程覆盖数值推理、损伤评估、风险与因果分析及修复规划等工程推理能力，为识别推理短板和评估可靠 AI 辅助工程决策进展提供测试平台。

Abstract: Artificial intelligence (AI), particularly large language models (LLMs) and vision-language models (VLMs), is increasingly applied in civil and structural engineering for disaster assessment, structural analysis, and engineering decision support. However, the extent to which current VLMs possess the reasoning capabilities required for reliable engineering judgments remains unclear. In this work, we introduce CivilBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating VLMs in civil engineering and disaster-related scenarios. CivilBench covers three major task families: Sequential Reasoning, Image-based Structural Understanding, and Open-world Understanding, encompassing numerical reasoning, structural damage assessment, risk inference, causal analysis, and repair planning. The benchmark is constructed through a systematic pipeline of domain-specific data collection, engineering-oriented captioning, expert annotation, question design, and quality verification. Evaluation of representative state-of-the-art VLMs reveals substantial limitations in domain-specific reasoning, with Sequential Reasoning emerging as a major bottleneck, particularly when models must infer numerical relationships from sparse structured observations. Further experiments show that numerical priors and external knowledge can alleviate these limitations, although their effectiveness depends on the model’s ability to reliably interpret and use the available evidence. CivilBench provides a capability-oriented testbed for identifying reasoning limitations and evaluating progress toward reliable AI-assisted engineering decision-making. The benchmark will be publicly available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/traceuryuan/CivilBench.

[222] Stream of Belief: Eliciting Collective Intelligence through Latent Belief Dynamics cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.MAPDF

Yu Yao, Jiayi Dong, Yilun Du

TL;DR: 论文将多智能体推理视为隐式信念动态寻求集体均衡的过程，提出Stream of Belief（SoB）框架，使智能体维护连续的潜在信念，并通过通信与反思迭代更新，直至进一步交流不再带来有意义的信息传播。实验表明该方法能跨任务和模型家族泛化。

Details

Motivation: 现有多智能体推理可能缺乏对智能体内部信念演化和集体收敛状态的统一建模，论文旨在通过隐式信念动态与集体均衡视角提升多智能体协作推理的泛化能力。

Result: 摘要未给出具体定量指标或benchmark，仅声称大量实验表明SoB在不同任务和模型家族上具有泛化性。

Insight: 创新点在于将多智能体推理形式化为连续潜在信念的动力学过程，并以通信不再产生有效信息传播作为集体信念均衡/收敛判据；可借鉴之处是将通信、反思与信念状态演化统一建模，并用信息传播饱和指导多智能体推理停止与扩展。

Abstract: In this work, we view multi-agent reasoning as a process of seeking a collective equilibrium of implicit belief dynamics and introduce Stream of Belief (SoB), where agents maintain continuous latent beliefs and iteratively refine them through communication and reflection. Our method seeks a collective belief state of a multi-agent system where further communication induces no meaningful information propagation. Through extensive experiments, we demonstrate the generalization of SoB across tasks and model families. More Broadly, our results suggest a new perspective on scaling multi-agent reasoning from belief dynamics.

[223] Procedure without Judgment: What Small Language Models Learn under an Exact Verifier cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.LGPDF

Arunkumar V, Manoranjan Gandhudi, Gangadharan G. R., Arun Prakash, S. Senthilkumar

TL;DR: 论文研究在授权策略阻止工具调用时，如何让解释器仅凭一次请求、一次决策和可查询策略，找出最小充分事实集合。作者用可精确计算的最小充分理由作为ground truth，比较前沿模型与小型模型在工具调用、微调和强化学习下的表现，发现小模型能学会固定的充分性检查流程并在训练策略上达到高准确率，但这种流程难以迁移到新策略。

Details

Motivation: 审计日志需要给出迫使策略做出决定的必要事实，且不应冗余；由于策略可执行、上下文可枚举，最小充分理由可精确计算，因此论文希望探究模型能否从无误差验证器中学习解释能力，而不是依赖代理指标。

Result: 前沿模型仅用工具约一半能找到精确理由，加入“缩短答案”的提示后Haiku 4.5从58%升至75%；4B模型用2000条删除算法轨迹微调后在训练策略上达92%，且算法教师优于前沿教师。跨三个未见公开策略时，学生答案仍充分的比例为94%但最小性降至48%，而Haiku在提示下47个样本全精确；基于精确奖励的RL未提升留出准确率并改变策略。

Insight: 创新在于用可精确求解的最小充分理由作为无误差验证器和评测基准，并系统比较教师来源、微调与RL对小型模型学习解释流程的影响；客观看，论文揭示了小模型学到的是一种固定的充分性检查调度而非可迁移的判断能力，精确oracle使训练效果更可读但不必然使训练更好。

Abstract: When an authorization policy blocks an agent’s tool call, the audit log should name the facts that forced the decision and nothing more. For an executable policy over an enumerable context space this minimal sufficient reason can be computed exactly, so an explanation is scored against ground truth rather than a proxy for it. We use that exactness to ask what a model can learn from a verifier that has no error in it. The explainer sees one request and one decision, never the policy, and has thirty turns in which it may call the policy on altered requests and ask whether a candidate set of facts is sufficient. Frontier models find the exact reason about half the time with the tools alone, and one sentence telling them to shrink the answer lifts Haiku 4.5 from 58% to 75%. A 4B model fine-tuned on 2000 traces of the deletion algorithm reaches 92% on the policy it was trained on. Teacher kind is what moves this: at matched data size the algorithm-taught student leads the frontier-taught one in all three training seeds, and the two arms never overlap. What the student learns is a fixed schedule of sufficiency checks, and the schedule does not travel. On three public policies it never saw, its answers stay sufficient (94%) and stop being minimal (48%), while Haiku under the same sentence is exact on all 47 episodes. Reinforcement learning from the exact reward leaves held-out accuracy where it was and inverts the strategy, from probing the policy to spending the entire budget on sufficiency checks. The oracle made the effect of training legible, but it did not make training better.

[224] Right Reason, Wrong Advice: Evaluating Recourse in LLM Explanations of Denied Requests cs.AI | cs.CL | cs.CYPDF

Arunkumar V

TL;DR: 论文关注LLM为规则系统拒绝请求时生成解释的场景，提出“追索有效性”（recourse validity）这一属性：若用户按照解释所引用的原因去修改，是否真能翻转拒绝决策。作者精确计算该属性，并用命中集（hitting-set）论证从策略本身预测“正确原因却无法追索”的失败模式，随后在7个规则系统（访问控制、美国福利资格）和20个LLM上评估解释的追索有效性。

Details

Motivation: 当多个规则各自独立地拒绝同一请求时，解释即使点出一个真实原因，用户修正后仍可能被其他规则拒绝，导致解释”正确但无用”；现有对解释正确性的评估无法捕捉这一缺陷，论文希望定义并衡量解释是否真正能帮助用户改变结果。

Result: 在7个规则系统中的6个里，当多条原因同时适用时，单一正确原因几乎从不带来追索；20个LLM上，无论计算式还是LLM评判的正确性检查，识别该失败的能力都接近随机，符合命中集论证的预测；而直接询问”按解释行动是否有效”的强评判模型能识别该问题。更强的与推理型模型表现更好，但在含4条以上独立原因的拒绝上仍大量失败；要求列出所有规则可提升各开放模型的表现。

Insight: 创新点在于提出”追索有效性”这一可精确计算的新评价维度，并用命中集理论从规则策略本身预测解释失败的条件，揭示”正确性”与”有用性”的错位。可借鉴之处：资格类决策的解释应直接由决策函数构造，并以”按解释行动能否改变结果”作为评判标准，而非仅检查所引原因是否正确。

Abstract: Language models increasingly write the explanations people receive when a rule system denies their request. If several rules deny the request independently, an explanation can name a true reason and still leave the person denied after they fix it. We call the missing property recourse validity: changing what the explanation cites, without changing what was asked for, can flip the decision. We compute it exactly, and a hitting-set argument predicts from the policy alone when a correct reason fails. In six of seven rule systems ported from access control and US benefit eligibility, a single correct reason almost never gives recourse when several reasons apply. Across 20 LLMs, checks of whether the cited reasons are correct, computed or asked of an LLM judge, are close to chance at spotting this failure, as the argument predicts. A strong judge asked whether acting on the explanation would work does spot it. Stronger and reasoning models do better but still fail on many denials with four or more independent reasons. Asking for every rule helps every open model with room to improve. Explanations of eligibility decisions should be built from the decision function and judged by whether acting on them works.

[225] Lasso: Towards Sustainable AI-Generated Media Detection with Intel QAT On-Chip Compression cs.AR | cs.AI | cs.CR | cs.CVPDF

Darsh Asher, Joshua Kalyanapu, Kaushal Mhapsekar, Bita Aslrousta, Amna Hassan

TL;DR: 论文提出 Lasso，一种利用 Intel QAT 片上压缩加速器进行 AI 生成内容检测的低成本、高性能方案。作者首次逆向 QAT 微架构，发现其处理时间具有数据结构相关特性，并将加速器转化为测量仪器。Lasso 可检测文本、视频、代码和图像，在文本任务上取得高准确率、极低延迟和显著能耗优势。

Details

Motivation: 合成文本、图像和视频快速增长，而纯软件检测器功耗高、速度慢、成本高且难以扩展。论文希望借助硬件加速器实现可持续、可扩展的 AI 生成媒体检测。

Result: 文本检测在 DetectRL 原始数据达 100% 准确率，改写后平均 92%，优于 Binoculars 的 78% 和 DetectGPT 的 55%；原始、改写、扰动平均 82%，超过五个基线。RAID 跨生成器平均 82%，八个留出领域 74%。检测耗时 0.74 微秒，较五个基线至少加速 83,784 倍，每文档能耗比 Binoculars 和 DetectGPT 低 99% 以上。视频、代码、图像检测准确率分别为 67.5%、70%、78%。

Insight: 论文宣称的创新点是首次逆向 Intel QAT 微架构，发现数据结构相关的时间特性，并将压缩加速器用作 AI 生成内容检测的测量仪器。客观看，其创新在于把硬件侧信道/压缩加速器行为引入 AIGC 检测，兼顾超低延迟、低能耗和多模态检测，为边缘实时检测提供了新思路。

Abstract: Synthetic text, images, and video are rising. Software-only detectors are power-hungry, too slow, and costly, and do not scale with demand. When software cannot scale, historically hardware often comes to the rescue. We perform the first reverse engineering of a compression accelerator–Intel QuickAssist Technology (QAT) microarchitecture and–find different amount of time on each, a novel data structure-dependent property. Using this information, we then build Lasso, a low-cost, high-performance detector for AI-generated content that turns the accelerator into a measuring instrument. For text detection, Lasso achieves 100% accuracy on original DetectRL text and retains 92% average accuracy after paraphrasing, compared with 78% for Binoculars and 55% for DetectGPT. Across original, paraphrased, and perturbed text, it achieves 82% average accuracy, outperforming all five baselines. With topic, length, and formatting matched, accuracy reaches 95% for instruction-tuned generators, including when the tested generator is unseen. On RAID, accuracy averages 82% when trained on one generator and tested on another, and 74% across eight held-out domains. Detection takes 0.74 microseconds, a speedup of at least 83,784x across five baselines. At the same time, Lasso consumes over 99% less energy per document than both Binoculars and DetectGPT. At the same time, Lasso detects AI-generated videos, software code, and images with 67.5%, 70% and 78% accuracy, respectively, with low latency and power opening avenues for practical real time and edge device detection of multimodality AI artifacts for the first time. No other compared technique supports detection across all four modalities: text, video, images, and code.

[226] Detection-Efficient Watermarking for Vision–Language Agents via Risk-Constrained Strength Allocation cs.CR | cs.CLPDF

Dumindu Samaraweera, Prashant Shekhar

TL;DR: 论文提出一种面向视觉语言智能体的风险感知语义水印框架，在解码时结合预测不确定性与零样本多模态相关性风险代理来动态分配水印强度。实验表明，在选定工作点上可大幅降低平均水印强度并减小困惑度变化，同时保持较高的水印检测ROC-AUC。论文还强调有限样本阈值校准会导致假阳性率漂移，建议报告校准方差以提升溯源审计可靠性。

Details

Motivation: 视觉语言智能体生成的内容可能被用户、下游智能体和自动化流程复用，因此需要可溯源与内容真实性审计机制，同时不能过度损害响应质量。论文关注如何在检测有效性和生成质量之间取得更优权衡。

Result: 在选定工作点，平均水印强度相对固定强度水印降低约59.4%，困惑度变化从0.3634降至0.1689，干净/改写文本ROC-AUC分别达到0.9552/0.9459。匹配强度分析显示，在相近平均强度下，风险约束分配策略的ROC-AUC显著高于固定强度、仅熵和仅关键性策略，说明其优势来自检测高效的分配策略而非单纯降低干预强度。

Insight: 创新点在于用预测不确定性和零样本多模态相关性风险代理动态分配水印强度，并通过单一风险惩罚λ提供可连续调节的检测-质量权衡前沿，无需重训练即可部署选择工作点。客观看，其价值在于提出“检测高效”而非“质量主导”的水印强度分配视角，并指出溯源审计中阈值校准方差报告的重要性。

Abstract: Vision–language agents generate descriptions, decisions, and instructions that may be reused by users, downstream agents, and automated workflows, creating a need for provenance mechanisms that support content authenticity and post-deployment auditing without unnecessarily degrading response quality. We present a risk-aware semantic watermarking framework that combines predictive uncertainty with a zero-shot multimodal relevance-risk proxy to allocate watermark strength during decoding. A single risk penalty $λ$ exposes a continuous operating frontier, allowing deployment-time selection of a detection–quality trade-off without model retraining. At a selected operating point, mean watermark strength is reduced by approximately 59.4% relative to fixed-strength watermarking, while perplexity change falls from 0.3634 to 0.1689 and clean/paraphrased ROC-AUC reaches 0.9552/0.9459. A matched-strength analysis shows that this advantage reflects the allocation policy rather than lower average intervention: at comparable mean strength, risk-constrained allocation achieves substantially higher ROC-AUC than fixed, entropy-only, and criticality-only policies, identifying it as detection-efficient rather than quality-dominant. We further show that threshold calibration on finite samples produces substantial false-positive-rate drift, motivating calibration variance reporting as standard practice for auditable provenance.

[227] HongguoTrending: A Longitudinal, Multimodal Archive of Trending Videos and Topics on a Leading Micro-Drama Platform cs.CY | cs.CVPDF

Rongxin Ouyang

TL;DR: 论文发布 HongguoTrending，一个面向中国头部微短剧平台 Hongguo 的纵向多模态榜单归档数据集。该数据集通过两阶段异步采集流水线，将 63,200 条榜单条目、632 个网页榜单小时和 157 个客户端小时（共 889 部不同短剧）与元数据、封面图、采样剧集视频及受众互动指标关联起来。论文还提供探索性分析，并开放 RESTful API，支持算法门控、流行度动态和多模态数字文化研究。

Details

Motivation: 微短剧正在重塑数字内容生产与消费，但缺乏将短剧系列与其平台可见性联系起来的纵向数据，限制了对这一新兴媒介的理解。论文旨在构建可长期追踪、多模态关联的榜单数据档案，以支撑相关实证研究。

Result: 数据规模包括 63,200 条排名记录、632 个网页榜单小时、157 个客户端小时和 889 部不同短剧，并关联元数据、封面、采样剧集视频和互动指标。探索性分析发现网页端与移动端榜单更替率不同、简介呈现生产驱动主流价值与亲情中心叙事、封面配色具有类型差异，且用户分享与次日排名提升存在强关联。

Insight: 创新点在于构建小时级纵向快照、跨网页与客户端榜单、连接排名条目与短剧多模态内容及互动指标的数据归档，并开放 API。客观来看，其价值在于把平台可见性、榜单动态与多模态文化特征结合，为算法守门和流行度机制研究提供可复用数据基础。

Abstract: Micro-dramas (duanju) are reshaping digital production and consumption, yet a lack of longitudinal data connecting series to their platform visibility persists, limiting our understanding of the emerging medium. We introduce HongguoTrending, a longitudinal, multimodal dataset of hourly snapshots from seven trending lists of Hongguo, China’s largest micro-drama platform. Collected through a two-stage asynchronous pipeline, the archive links 63,200 ranking entries across 632 web list-hours and 157 client hours (889 distinct series) to metadata, cover images, sampled episode videos, and audience engagement metrics. Exploratory analyses show distinct turnover rates between web and mobile trending lists, production-driven mainstream values alongside kinship-centered synopses, genre-specific cover palettes, and strong associations between user sharing and next-day rank gains. Accessible via a RESTful API, this dataset supports empirical research on algorithmic gatekeeping, popularity dynamics, and multimodal digital culture.

[228] Sivia: Learning to Draw, Learning to Learn cs.GR | cs.AI | cs.CV | cs.MAPDF

Feng Yuan, Xinyi Gao, Zijun Sun, Haoyue Li, Menglei Hua

TL;DR: 论文提出 Sivia，一个面向学术论文概览图的自动生成系统：它阅读论文、规划方法关系、参考近期顶会论文的视觉组织，并生成设计方案用于图像生成。系统通过人类反馈进行两层递归自我改进：一层提升绘图技能，另一层改进提出修订的更新器，同时用个性化档案适配用户审美而不改变科学内容。作者还构建了诊断研究并验证了关系规划与双层学习对准确率、可读性和视觉质量的提升。

Details

Motivation: 论文概览图通常是读者最先看到的内容，必须准确解释方法且视觉精美，但自动生成高质量概览图需要正确的关系规划、合适的视觉组织和对用户审美的适配。现有方法容易遗漏关键关系，且缺乏可持续的自我改进机制。

Result: 对445篇论文的1,964张概览图进行诊断研究，发现多数错误是遗漏，源派生关系规划可将必需关系准确率提升最多19.85个百分点。在48篇测试论文上，两层学习达到93.54% RRA，分别比初始技能、Fixed-updater和GEPA基线高15.31、9.38和8.33个百分点；可读性和视觉质量从3.95/4.00提升到4.70/4.78（五分制），学习到的展示偏好档案将喜欢程度从4.02提升到4.73，采用数从34/48提升到45/48。

Insight: 创新点在于将概览图生成拆解为关系规划、视觉组织借鉴和设计合成，并引入人类引导的两层递归自我改进，使绘图技能和更新器共同进化；同时用源派生关系计划减少遗漏，并用个性化展示档案在保持科学内容固定的前提下适配审美偏好。客观来看，将“学会画图”和“学会学习”分层优化，以及用诊断研究指导关系规划，是较有借鉴价值的设计。

Abstract: A paper’s overview figure is often the first thing readers see: it must explain the method correctly and look polished. We present Sivia, an overview-figure system that reads the paper, plans its relations, adapts visual organization from recent top-conference papers, and composes a design for image generation. Sivia improves with use through human-guided recursive self-improvement (RSI) at two levels: learning to draw revises its drawing skill from feedback on accuracy and presentation, and learning to learn revises the updater that proposes those revisions. A personal profile adapts presentation to its user’s aesthetic preferences while the scientific content stays fixed. A diagnostic study of 1,964 overviews for 445 papers (17,973 relation judgments) shows that most errors are omissions and that source-derived relation plans raise required-relation accuracy (RRA) by up to 19.85 points. On 48 test papers, learning both levels reaches 93.54% RRA, 15.31, 9.38, and 8.33 points above the initial skill, the Fixed-updater, and the GEPA baselines, while readability and visual quality rise from 3.95 and 4.00 to 4.70 and 4.78 on five-point scales. Learned presentation profiles raise liking from 4.02 to 4.73 and adoption from 34 to 45 of 48 tasks. Code and released artifacts are available at https://github.com/exsinger-hub/Sivia

[229] Sidewalk Stewards: A Visual Analytics Approach for Interactive Topology Repair of Sidewalk Networks cs.HC | cs.CV | cs.CYPDF

Stefan Cobeli, Leonardo Ferreira, Logan Loch, Luiza Melo, Peyman Baghershahi

TL;DR: 论文提出 Sidewalk Stewards，一个面向人行道网络拓扑修复的可视分析系统。该系统从航空影像自动提取的人行道网络中检测候选拓扑错误，支持用户通过联动空间视图进行交互式修正，并实时反馈网络质量。作者通过对比用户研究、跨城市案例和定量评估验证了系统的有效性。

Details

Motivation: 准确的人行道网络数据对城市可达性、路径规划和基础设施规划很重要，但自动化提取流程常产生断开组件、悬挂边、漏连、畸形交叉口等拓扑错误。全局自动修复难以替代人工判断，而现有实践者缺少高效修复工具。

Result: 对比用户研究表明，相比传统工作流，系统能帮助更快、更完整地识别和修复错误；跨城市案例展示了不同城市情境下的工作流；定量评估表明少量人工修正即可提升多项人行道质量指标。

Insight: 创新点在于将自动错误检测、交互式拓扑修复、联动空间视图和实时质量反馈整合为可视分析系统，弥合自动提取结果与可部署人行道网络之间的差距。

Abstract: Accurate pedestrian network data is foundational to urban accessibility, routing, and infrastructure planning, yet such data remains scarce and difficult to produce at scale. Automated extraction pipelines have made significant strides by leveraging computer vision to derive sidewalk networks from aerial imagery, and have seen real-world adoption by municipalities seeking cost-effective inventory solutions. Yet, these pipelines consistently produce topological errors (e.g., disconnected components, dangling edges, missed connections, malformed intersections) that undermine the utility of the extracted networks for routing and accessibility analysis. Correcting these errors requires situated human judgment that global automated repair strategies cannot replicate, yet practitioners currently lack dedicated tools to support this work efficiently. We present Sidewalk Stewards, a visual analytics system that bridges the gap between automated extraction and a deployment-ready pedestrian network. Sidewalk Stewards detects candidate topology errors, supports interactive user-guided correction through coordinated spatial views, and provides real-time quality feedback as edits are applied. We evaluate Sidewalk Stewards through a comparative user study, case studies across cities, and a quantitative evaluation. Compared with conventional workflows, the system facilitates error identification and enables faster and more complete correction. The case studies illustrate the workflow across different urban contexts, and the quantitative evaluation shows that a small number of user corrections can enhance multiple sidewalk quality metrics. Sidewalk Stewards is available at urbantk.org/sidewalk.

cs.LG [Back]

[230] Quantize, Qualify, Rerank: A Recipe for Compressing LLMs Without Losing Quality cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Thamme Gowda

TL;DR: 论文面向 WMT26 模型压缩受限赛道，在单张 H100 上压缩 google/gemma-3-12b-it，用于三个翻译方向。方法包括去除无用视觉模块和非任务词表、采用 int8 权重或 fp8 激活量化，并结合 Cometoid best-of-4 重排序提升压缩模型质量。作者用配对 bootstrap 和多指标校验评估 4-bit 量化的质量损失，最终压缩系统在 WMT26 无参考指标下与 bf16 保持竞争力。

Details

Motivation: 大模型部署成本高，需要压缩以降低服务开销，但单一自动指标可能掩盖质量损失，因此论文关注在压缩 LLM 的同时可靠评估并尽量保持翻译质量。

Result: 去除无用视觉栈和非任务词表、使用 int8 权重或 fp8 激活未发现显著损失，int4 仍有小幅残余损失；Cometoid best-of-4 重排序在 WMT25 测试集上同时提升 8-bit 和 4-bit 系统，WMT26 后提交结果显示两者在无参考指标下均与 bf16 有竞争力，重排序变体间小差异被视为噪声。

Insight: 创新点在于提出“量化—质量校验—重排序”的压缩配方，强调用配对 bootstrap 和多指标/人工元评估交叉验证压缩质量，并发现 QLoRA healing 会过拟合校准域；可借鉴的是将压缩、评估协议和轻量重排序结合以稳定保持下游任务质量。

Abstract: Compressing large language models lowers serving cost, but a single automatic metric may miss quality loss. For the WMT26 Model Compression constrained track, we compress google/gemma-3-12b-it (24.4 GB in bf16) for three translation directions on one H100. Paired bootstrap analysis exposes metric disagreement on 4-bit quantization; guided by WMT24 human meta-evaluation, we use MetricX24-XXL as primary and CometKiwi-XXL as a cross-check. Removing the unused vision stack and non-task vocabulary and using int8 weights or fp8 activations causes no resolved loss, whereas int4 leaves a small residual. QLoRA healing overfits its calibration domain. A Cometoid best-of-4 reranker at $T=0.3$ improves both the 8-bit and 4-bit systems under WMT25 test set. On post-submission WMT26, both remain competitive with bf16 under reference-free metrics; the small difference between the reranked variants is treated as noise.

[231] GRAFT: Cross-Backbone LoRA Reuse for Continual Language and Multimodal Learning cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Ha Pham Thien Dinh, Ming Liu, Jiesi Guo, Matteo Vergani, Kewen Liao

TL;DR: 论文提出 GRAFT 框架，用于跨骨干网络的 LoRA 适配器复用：从模态感知的适配器库中检索与目标任务最相关的预训练 LoRA，并通过学习到的线性桥接层将源特征空间映射到目标骨干的特征空间，从而在持续学习中把语言模型学到的能力迁移到多模态模型。作者在 Super-NaturalInstructions 的 10 个文本任务上验证 Qwen2.5 LoRA 到 Qwen2.5-VL 的迁移，并在 5 个多模态任务上直接复用 Qwen2.5-VL LoRA。

Details

Motivation: 现有持续学习中的 LoRA 等参数高效微调方法通常只能在相同骨干网络之间复用预训练适配器，难以将语言模型获得的能力迁移到多模态模型，限制了跨模型、跨模态的能力复用。

Result: 在 10 个 Super-NaturalInstructions 文本任务和 5 个多模态任务上，与随机初始化的 LoRA 适配器相比，GRAFT 在大多数任务上取得性能提升；摘要未给出具体数值或 SOTA 结论。

Insight: 创新点在于结合模态感知的适配器检索与源/目标特征空间之间的可学习线性桥接，实现跨骨干网络的 LoRA 复用，尤其是从语言模型到多模态模型的能力迁移，为持续学习中的适配器复用提供了简单有效的机制。

Abstract: In continual learning, parameter-efficient fine-tuning enables large language models to acquire new capabilities through lightweight adapters such as LoRA, yet the reuse of pretrained adapters is typically restricted to models sharing the same backbone. This limits the transfer of learned capabilities from language models to multimodal models. We propose GRAFT (Generalist Reuse of Adapters via Feature-space Transfer), a framework for cross-backbone LoRA reuse. GRAFT retrieves the most relevant pretrained LoRA adapter from a modality-aware library and maps it into the target backbone through a learned linear bridge between corresponding source and target feature spaces. We evaluate GRAFT on ten Super-NaturalInstructions text tasks, transferring Qwen2.5 LoRAs to Qwen2.5-VL, and five multimodal tasks, where Qwen2.5-VL LoRAs are directly reused. Compared with randomly initialized LoRA adapters, GRAFT improves performance on most evaluated tasks. These results show that GRAFT provides a simple and effective mechanism for reusing learned capabilities across language and multimodal models in continual learning.

[232] SynthDCB: World Distillation for Scalable Device Control Benchmarking cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Zichen Zhu, Dingye Liu, Nan Jiang, Danyang Zhang, Hang Zheng

TL;DR: 论文提出 SynthDCB，一个通过“世界蒸馏”构建的可扩展设备控制基准，将设备行为、交互约束和环境效应转成模块化可执行组件并组合为有状态交互世界，同时统一表示工具发现、世界执行与任务合成。该基准覆盖 Home、Car、Phone 三个领域，包含 114 类设备、1166 个函数和 95 种事件，支持五类任务族、32 个子类型，并在 2560 个测试任务上评估 7 个模型。

Details

Motivation: 扩展设备控制评估需要同时扩展智能体交互的世界和待求解任务；论文希望以可执行世界构建为基础，实现可扩展、可验证的环境感知与设备控制基准。

Result: 7 个模型在 2560 个测试任务上最佳达到 68.2% Pass@1；错误分析显示答案交付、可行性诊断和时间协调仍是难点。构建实验表明世界蒸馏相对 Codex 在不同推理强度下降低 token 消耗 0.9-66.0% 和 46.2-92.5%，并覆盖更广能力。

Insight: 创新点在于用世界蒸馏把设备知识转化为模块化可执行世界，并用统一能力表示连接工具发现、世界执行与任务合成；其有状态设计支持基于状态正确性和工具调用轨迹的验证与评估，为可扩展设备控制基准提供了可借鉴的构建范式。

Abstract: Scaling device-control evaluation requires scaling both the worlds agents interact with and the tasks they must solve. We introduce SynthDCB, a scalable benchmark for environment awareness and device control built through world distillation. World distillation transforms knowledge of device behaviors, interaction constraints, and environmental effects into modular executable components, which are composed into interactive worlds with explicit states, actions, and temporal dynamics. A unified capability representation connects tool discovery, world execution, and task synthesis, allowing new capabilities to enter evaluation through a shared construction pipeline. SynthDCB instantiates Home, Car, and Phone domains with 114 device classes, 1,166 functions, and 95 events, supporting five task families with 32 subtypes. The stateful design enables task validation and agent evaluation through state correctness and tool-call traces. We evaluate seven models on 2,560 test tasks; the best achieves 68.2% Pass@1. Error analysis reveals challenges in answer delivery, feasibility diagnosis, and temporal coordination. Construction experiments demonstrate scalability across domains and token efficiency: world distillation reduces token consumption by 0.9-66.0% and 46.2-92.5% relative to Codex with low and xhigh reasoning effort, respectively, while achieving broader capability coverage. SynthDCB makes executable world construction the basis of scalable device-control benchmarking, connecting an expanding space of capabilities and interactions to verifiable agent evaluation.

[233] SERAG: SEmantical and Relational approach for Anomaly detection on knowledge Graphs cs.LG | cs.CLPDF

Ludovic Moncla, Antoine Salazar, Yassir Lairgi, Khalid Benabdeslem, Rémy Cazabet

TL;DR: 论文提出 SERAG，一种面向知识图谱的监督式异常检测方法，用于识别文本构建知识图谱中“单独看似合理但与关系上下文不一致”的事实。该方法分别计算语义分数（对主语、关系、宾语标签分别编码）和关系分数（基于关系图卷积网络），再将两者标准化、校准并融合。在 ICEWS18 子集上使用 LLM 生成的词汇受限合成异常，并在 pooled 与 chronological 两种划分下评估。

Details

Motivation: 从文本构建的知识图谱可能包含局部合理但关系上下文不一致的事实，单一语义或关系信号难以充分检测此类异常，因此需要融合文本语义与图结构关系信息。

Result: 在 10% 异常比例下，SERAG 在 pooled 和 chronological 划分上的测试 AUPRC 分别为 0.321 和 0.258，显著高于最强适配基线的 0.159 和 0.146；融合通常优于单独语义或关系分支，且增加异常监督可提升性能。

Insight: 创新点在于将主语/关系/宾语的语义合理性与关系图卷积网络捕捉的关系上下文合理性进行校准融合，体现了文本语义信号与图关系信号在知识图谱异常检测中的互补性。

Abstract: Knowledge graphs constructed from text can contain facts that are individually plausible yet inconsistent with their relational context. We introduce SERAG, a supervised anomaly detector that combines two complementary plausibility estimates: a semantic score computed from separately encoded subject, relation, and object labels, and a relational score obtained through a relational graph convolutional network. The scores are standardized, calibrated, and fused. We evaluate the method on a subset of ICEWS18 with vocabulary-constrained synthetic anomalies generated by an LLM, using pooled and chronological splits. At 10% anomaly prevalence, SERAG achieves test AUPRCs of 0.321 and 0.258, respectively, compared with 0.159 and 0.146 for the strongest adapted baseline. Fusion improves mean test AUPRC over either branch alone, with a larger gain in the pooled protocol and a smaller validation-selected gain in the chronological protocol. Additional anomaly supervision improves performance. These results support the complementarity of textual and relational signals for detecting synthetic anomalies under the evaluated protocols.

[234] Rethinking Offline On-Policy Distillation: From Scalar Advantages to Distributional Supervision cs.LG | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Qi Sun, Siyue Zhang, Tingyu Song, Yilun Zhao, Chen Zhao

Motivation: 在线OPD需反复用教师评估学生新rollout，计算开销大；离线方法如Lightning OPD通过缓存固定参考rollout上的教师log概率降低成本，但在多轮智能体搜索中持续弱于同教师训练的SFT起点。论文旨在解决离线OPD中教师-参考失配与标量优势监督导致的分布平坦化问题。

Abstract: On-policy distillation (OPD) transfers teacher capabilities through token-level feedback on student-generated trajectories, but repeatedly evaluating fresh rollouts with the teacher is computationally expensive. Offline methods such as Lightning OPD reduce this cost by caching recorded tokens’ teacher log-probabilities on fixed reference rollouts. By extending the idea to a multi-turn agentic search setup, we find that it consistently underperforms the SFT starting point trained by the same teacher. We empirically observe greater teacher–reference mismatch than in mathematical reasoning and post-training distributional flattening, and theoretically show that scalar advantage supervision on fixed rollouts admits solutions with flattened output distributions under suitable conditions. Motivated by these findings, we propose Distributional On-Policy Distillation (DistOPD), a simple yet effective offline OPD method that retains candidate-token probabilities from both reference and teacher at selected positions and aggregates the remaining parts into a residual token. On agentic search, DistOPD achieves performance comparable to online OPD while improving student–teacher alignment and using training GPU-hours comparable to Lightning OPD.

Abstract: Sparse and delayed rewards make reinforcement learning challenging for long-horizon language agents. On-policy distillation (OPD) complements environmental rewards with dense teacher feedback on student-generated contexts. Standard OPD can misalign supervision with relative teacher competence, student trajectory outcomes, and the temporal structure of task execution. Recent variants adjust guidance through divergence-based weighting and temporal schedules, while joint calibration from task-completion experience remains underexplored. We introduce Experience-Calibrated On-Policy Distillation (ECOD), which allocates teacher supervision at the task, trajectory, and turn levels. ECOD compares teacher and student success-rate posteriors under matched task conditions, restricts direct supervision to failed student trajectories, and derives a temporal prior from successful teacher lengths. The resulting weight applies to teacher losses or teacher-derived advantages. We evaluate ECOD on ALFWorld and WebShop with Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct and Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct. Under matched teacher settings, ECOD improves standard OPD by up to 4.06% in relative ALFWorld unseen success. Across both model scales, ECOD-assisted SOD, TCOD-F2B, and ATOD configurations yield average paired relative gains of 6.20% on ALFWorld unseen and 7.05% on WebShop, with WebShop gains ranging from 2.29% to 21.60%. These results support experience-calibrated supervision allocation as a reusable mechanism across distinct distillation objectives.

Abstract: Language models acquire a vast array of concepts and abilities from next-token prediction alone. We introduce an interpretability framework that exposes how this single loss relates to the development of different concepts at different points during pretraining. We propose Concept Energy, a measure of the concept-specific alignment between a concept subspace and the average gradient outer product (AGOP) of the next-token-prediction loss. The concept subspace captures where the concept currently lives in the model’s representation; AGOP captures the directions to which the loss is most sensitive. Across 19 checkpoints of Pythia-410M and -1B and 12 lexical, syntactic, and semantic concepts, we find that the first peak in Concept Energy generally occurs at or before the steepest increase in probe decodability. Furthermore, whereas probe performance usually increases monotonically throughout training, Concept Energy is not confined to a single peak; some concepts exhibit sustained or repeated engagement across pretraining, suggesting that concept learning may require continual reinforcement or occur at multiple points. Our results indicate that the loss contributes to concept learning in a myriad of ways that simple probe performance alone cannot reveal.

Abstract: Generative models play a rapidly growing role in the design and simulation of molecules. The most widely used applications of generative models are in large language models (LLMs), owing to the natural flexibility of language for specifying and answering queries. However, generalist LLMs do not effectively handle large sets of 3D coordinates, whereas specialist generative models of 3D molecules cannot reach the controllability afforded by language. To bridge these capabilities, we propose Nahual, a decoder-only autoregressive diffusion model for any sequence of text and 3D molecules. To enable expressive autoregression on continuous coordinates, we propose next-token diffusion, whereby a causal transformer denoises each token while attending to the clean tokens before it, without increasing context size. We train Nahual on a curated set of twelve 3D chemistry tasks ranging from microsolvation to molecular conformer search to adsorption on metal surfaces, with associated evaluation metrics and baselines. The result is a single set of end-to-end-trained weights that simultaneously performs all tasks and surpasses state-of-the-art models specialized for crystal structure prediction and property-conditional molecule generation. Our results demonstrate the viability of scaling generalist decoder-only models for native multimodal understanding and generation across language and chemistry. Code is available at https://github.com/the-matter-lab/nahual.

Abstract: Masked diffusion models (MDMs) have emerged as a promising paradigm for language modeling, enabling parallel token generation with competitive performance. Yet standard MDMs suffer from two fundamental limitations: (1) inability to revise tokens, and (2) sparse training signal. We revisit hollow transformers, which address both limitations by predicting each token from its surrounding context, independently of the input at that position. We introduce the Leave-One-Out Transformer (LOOT), a more efficient and expressive architecture that advances hollow transformers through two complementary advances. First, we redesign the merging mechanism to enable frequent interaction between left and right contexts, substantially improving predictive performance over prior hollow transformers. Second, we derive a lower-variance estimator of the MDM NELBO that supervises all tokens and improves validation perplexity. Together, these advances yield a competitive standalone diffusion language model capable of effective self-correction during inference. On LM1B, LOOT matches the strongest dense-supervision MDM baseline in validation perplexity. On OpenWebText, LOOT achieves higher MAUVE and better generation quality-diversity tradeoffs than prior remasking methods, using $8\times$ fewer forward evaluations and $3.5\times$ fewer inference FLOPs.

Abstract: Thinking with images empowers vision-language models (VLMs) to use an external Zoom-in tool for fine-grained visual search. Recent works employ supervised fine-tuning (SFT) and reinforcement learning (RL) with tool-specific designs to enable such capabilities. However, achieving logical reasoning alongside accurate and efficient tool use remains a significant challenge. To address this, we shift the focus away from increasing RL complexity and instead identify SFT data quality as a key bottleneck. We then propose LogT (short for Logically Think with Images), a fully automated SFT data engine that explicitly enforces logic-chain-guided reasoning. LogT generates an SFT dataset featuring challenging, visually grounded questions and structured tool-use traces with human-like logic. We validate our approach by fine-tuning two base models, Qwen2.5-VL-7B and InternVL3.5-8B, on the dataset and evaluating them across seven benchmark test sets. We show that LogT-SFT based on Qwen2.5-VL-7B outperforms the state-of-the-art trained with both SFT and RL, despite using 3.1$\times$ less data and $>120\times$ fewer GPU hours. Furthermore, applying a simple RL recipe without tool-specific design on LogT-SFT yields a model that surpasses prior methods with complex RL setups by a substantial 9.59-point margin. In addition to strong performance gains, our model exhibits higher tool-use accuracy and efficiency, as well as more structured and logically consistent reasoning traces, directly validating the effectiveness of our approach.

Abstract: Vision-language models (VLMs) increasingly read a scene and report it to someone who acts on the report, sometimes under objectives that differ from that person’s. We ask whether a stated incentive moves what a VLM reports, and whether this changes when the value must be read from pixels rather than given as text. In seeded synthetic scenes, a model reads the position of a target on a labelled axis and reports one integer to a fixed receiver; it is paid, in simulation, for accuracy or for a report a few units to one side, and every scene is also presented with the true value as text. Across a pilot and three follow-up studies with hash-frozen protocols, four small open VLMs from three families, and 15,170 held-out trials, a stated payoff moved reports in both modalities, and exact compliance at three units was significantly lower with the image than with text for three of four models; Qwen2.5-VL 7B showed no reliable difference. Adding the true value as text to the image prompt removed the gap in every model. For InternVL3 the gap vanished on scenes it read correctly when it wrote its reading first; for Gemma 3 it persisted. For Qwen2.5-VL 3B, which read every scene correctly, the gap held in four of five payoff paraphrases, nearly vanished when the model wrote its reading before its report or when the prompt stated that the client wants the truth, vanished with an unpaid goal, and persisted when the model reported before stating its reading; how often it shaded at all, even with text, depended strongly on the wording. When told that the client wants the true value, three of four models still shaded every text report. Visual input did not make these advisors reliably more truthful; it made compliance with a stated incentive depend on whether the read value is made explicit and on output order, a dependence that text-only evaluations and mean-shift metrics do not reveal.

Abstract: LLM agents operating repeatedly in the same environment, such as a code repository, a database, or an application suite, encounter tasks that share latent structure. Experience can reveal this structure, allowing agents to reuse environment knowledge and learn from environmental feedback. Agents can adapt at test-time using this experience through two channels: retaining it in context and updating their weights. These channels are usually studied separately, leaving unclear what each contributes and when they complement each other. We compare in-context learning (ICL), reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards using GRPO, and self-distillation using SDPO, alone and in combination, using a shared online protocol and modular framework. Agents encounter matched task streams, are evaluated on each task before adapting to it, and learn only from their own attempts and environment feedback. We evaluate 14 adaptation mechanisms and a stateless baseline with Qwen3.5-9B on 109 tasks from four environments drawn from SWE-bench Verified, AppWorld, ScienceWorld, and BIRD-Critic-SQLite, using five task orders per environment. ICL provides the largest standalone gain: its best policy raises mean success across environments from 28.8% to 49.4%. Adding GRPO to this policy achieves the highest mean success, 51.6%. While adding GRPO improves the overall mean under every ICL policy, SDPO has mixed effects. Trace analyses show fewer lookups and shorter attempts under ICL, consistent with reusing knowledge of the shared structure. However, ICL also frequently skips inspection and verification for the current task. Adding GRPO to ICL helps restore these behaviors while preserving its reduced environment lookups. These observations suggest that reinforcement learning with verifiable rewards can refine how agents use retained experience, motivating the joint study of context management and weight updates.

TL;DR: 论文关注LLM作为AI科学家时的“研究品味”，将其操作化为给定研究目标和当前结果后选择未来研究方向的任务。作者构建了来自19篇ML论文、覆盖4个子领域的80组成对比较，每组包含作者推荐方向与相似论文采样得到的合理干扰方向，并在8个LLM上评估作者对齐、稳定分歧和不稳定选择等行为指标。

Details

Motivation: 现有LLM的科研能力评测多依赖可验证目标，但开放式科研中往往需要在没有客观答案前选择研究方向，而LLM的研究品味尚缺乏测量。论文试图刻画和评估LLM在未来研究方向选择上的偏好，而非简单预测文献计量指标或把作者选择视为绝对正确。

Result: 在8个LLM上，作者对齐率为45.0%至67.5%，稳定分歧率为15.0%至36.2%；这些分歧在相似性控制、提示消融和作者偏好框架检查下大体持续。模型间一致性表明部分非作者偏好可能为多个模型共享，且模型倾向表现出向规模化/泛化以及方法扩展与基础设施/数据扩展之间权衡的移动。

Insight: 创新点在于用“未来研究方向二选一”来操作化研究品味，并引入作者对齐、稳定分歧和不稳定选择等行为度量；客观上看，其可借鉴之处是采用顺序控制、作者推荐方向与相似论文干扰方向配对的评测设计，并结合迁移类别标签和推理样例分析模型偏好走向。

Abstract: Research taste is increasingly discussed in the context of AI scientists, yet remains little studied or measured in LLMs. This judgment matters especially in open-ended research, where a direction must be chosen before a verifiable objective is available. We operationalize research taste through one task of the scientific workflow: choosing which future research direction to pursue given a research goal and current results. Rather than predicting downstream scientometric metrics or treating author choices as objectively correct, we evaluate models against human-authored future-work directions and report author alignment, stable divergence, and unstable choice as behavioral measures of research-direction preference. We construct an order-controlled evaluation of 80 pairwise comparisons from 19 ML papers published between December 2025 and February 2026 across four subdomains. Each query presents a research goal, hypotheses tested with key results, and two candidate future directions: one author-recommended direction and one plausible distractor sampled from a similar paper. Across eight LLMs, author alignment ranges from 45.0% to 67.5%, while stable divergence ranges from 15.0% to 36.2%. These divergences largely persist under similarity controls, prompt ablations, and an author-preference framing check, and inter-model agreement suggests that some non-author preferences are shared across models. We characterize what models diverge toward using transition-category labels and selected reasoning examples, finding recurring movement toward scaling/generalization and trade-offs between methodological and infrastructure/data extensions. We view this as an early descriptive evaluation for eliciting research taste profiles in LLMs, and as a step toward understanding and steering their research preferences as they take on more autonomous roles in novel open-ended scientific discovery.

Details

Motivation: OPSD 虽能通过冻结教师模型蒸馏提升语言模型推理，但存在学生模型终止行为学习不可靠的问题，表现为过早停止和推理停滞后的重复性过度生成。论文旨在从“继续/停止”决策角度修复这一终止不匹配。

Insight: 创新点在于识别并系统分析了 OPSD 训练中 EOS 教师-学生差异增大、长度受限轨迹易被无效重复主导的问题，并设计互补的终止感知蒸馏目标：显式对齐是否继续推理，同时惩罚失败轨迹中的重复续写。

Abstract: On-Policy Self-Distillation (OPSD) improves language model reasoning by distilling from a frozen teacher initialized identically to the student and conditioned on privileged information. However, we identify an underexplored termination mismatch in OPSD: the student fails to reliably learn when to continue and when to stop. This mismatch manifests in two opposing failure modes-premature termination, where reasoning stops before sufficient progress is made, and repetition-driven over-generation, where the model continues generating after reasoning has stalled. Our analysis shows that the teacher-student discrepancy on EOS grows during OPSD training, while length-capped trajectories are frequently dominated by unproductive repetition. To address this issue, we propose TA-OPSD (Termination-Aware On-Policy Self-Distillation), which augments the original OPSD objective with two targeted objectives. Stop/Continue Distillation addresses premature termination by explicitly aligning the teacher and student on whether reasoning should continue, while Repetition-Aware Unlikelihood Training addresses repetition-driven over-generation by discouraging repetitive continuations in the student’s failed trajectories. The resulting objective improves termination behavior from complementary directions: continuing when further reasoning is needed and stopping when reasoning becomes unproductive. Experiments on mathematical reasoning tasks with Qwen3 (1.7B/4B/8B) show that TA-OPSD consistently outperforms OPSD and other baselines across all three model scales. Beyond the performance gains, ablation and behavioral analyses show that the two proposed objectives effectively mitigate their corresponding termination failures, reducing both premature termination and repetition-driven over-generation.

Abstract: Embodied capabilities such as visual grounding, spatial reasoning, navigation, and driving understanding are often developed in separate vision-language specialists fine-tuned from a common pretrained model.Deploying the specialists separately multiplies storage, whereas merging them into one dense model forces conflicting task updates to share parameters and loses part of each specialist’s expertise.We introduce UNITE, a framework that consolidates such specialists into a compact shared-backbone mixture of experts. UNITE keeps the feed-forward block of each specialist as a routable expert and represents the expert bank through a shared-anchor one-bit factorization: a shared floating-point anchor plus expert-specific, row-scaled binary deviations.The anchor is optimized jointly with the scales and signs through closed-form alternating updates, using only source weights and no calibration data.Router adaptation then adjusts token-level expert selection with the backbone and experts frozen, updating fewer than $0.6$M parameters ($<0.01%$ of the $8.8$B active parameters). Across $22$ benchmarks and R2R Val-Unseen, UNITE matches six static merging methods in mean retention of best-specialist performance, leads all of them on Scan2Cap, ScanQA, and all four navigation metrics, and surpasses every source specialist on all five 3D scene understanding benchmarks (up to $+19.1$ on Scan2Cap) and on R2R navigation. Relative to the uncompressed MoE, factorization is nearly lossless on $21$ of $22$ benchmarks; the exception is VSI-Bench, where frame-count experiments suggest impaired use of cross-frame evidence.UNITE thus consolidates complementary embodied capabilities near single-model storage.

Abstract: Fault diagnosis in power management systems running multiple loads relies on experts manually inspecting current and voltage waveforms, which fails to scale across deployed units. Abstract: Classical molecular similarity is central to chemical information systems, yet molecule-language models trained on paired structure-text data do not necessarily organize molecular embeddings according to graded structural relationships. These results show that established chemoinformatics priors can make molecule-language representations more chemically faithful while retaining their multimodal utility.

Abstract: A popular ideation recipe treats an embedding map of existing work as a guide: pick points far from everything and decode them into ideas. I test four ways such distances could guide ideation against what appeared later. (1) Far random directions are not text: no later item reaches a raw cosine above about 0.10 with one (after centring or whitening, 22 of 24 cells stay out of reach), and an LLM decoder shown a target’s neighbours, with score-only feedback, writes those neighbours in all six target sets. A neighbour-free search writes coherent text at median cosine 0.57 and 0.47 to interior gaps, beating the nearest existing item on 15 and 14 of 20, but only 0.07 and 0.06 to far points. (2) On k-means cells of a past-only map, the registered hole score mostly tracks cell size and position; three density-based gap scores forecast which cells grow fastest at or below chance (AUC 0.30 to 0.66) and add nothing to momentum in Steam and arXiv, with patents inconclusive; more isolated new Steam games are slightly better reviewed. (3) LLM continuations of arXiv papers stay closer to the source than papers that cite it, under three user prompts and against proposal rewrites (gpt-4o) and April-December 2023 papers (OLMo). Critique lengthens this step beyond content-free revision, replicated on 150 new papers. Revealing a real follow-up’s title turns the ideas by 0.032 along a follow-up-specific direction beyond revision; reviewer, oracle and distance feedback add 0.13, 0.08 and 0.34 of that turn (upper bounds 0.46, 0.46, 0.70), and their turn is not separable from revision or their longer step. (4) For inspiration material graded by distance, no inverted U was detected, on an anticipation margin that tracks format more than content. Original tests were registered before running, follow-ups (thirteen requested in two AI-agent reviews) after the main results; all are dated only by local git commits.

The damage magnitude does not replicate, and five pre-registered attempts to explain it are reported as they fell. Abstract: The National Hurricane Center routinely releases Tropical Cyclone Discussions that offer insights into its tropical cyclone forecasts. This retrospective study shows the added value of the forecasters’ discussions and suggests that multi-modal learning can help understand the predictive contribution of expert human judgment. Abstract: Language models typically increase per-token computation through deeper or looped layers and latent reasoning steps, while richer residual connections improve information flow across layers. We instead increase computational capacity: the number of active computational states a model maintains. We introduce the Lattice of Latents, a set of per-layer horizontal latent streams that run recurrently along time, alongside the vertical residual stream that flows through depth. Like hyper-connections, mHC, and attention or value residuals, the Lattice enhances the residual stream, but rather than adding or rerouting residual pathways through depth, it provides companion computational states that persist across tokens. Unlike hybrid Transformer-SSM architectures, whose recurrent states primarily serve as internal memory for sequence mixing, these latents directly condition the vertical stream’s attention, KV-cache writes, MLP computation, and decoding. On Transformers trained on 20B FineWeb-Edu tokens, a 406M-parameter Lattice model lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 to 14.40 over a parameter-matched Transformer. These gains extend across architectural variants. The Lattice composes with prior residual-stream enhancements: with hyper-connections and input residuals, it lowers validation perplexity from 15.41 (base Transformer) and 14.22 (Transformer with the same enhancements) to 13.61. On Gated DeltaNet, Mamba-2, Triadic GDN, and GDN-Mamba-2 hybrids, it improves perplexity at every tested native state size, with Lattice-GDN and Lattice-Triadic-GDN variants outperforming pure baselines with 4x larger native states. Abstract: Robot agents can improve reusable skills, planning procedures, and recovery strategies from execution feedback, yet a fixed practice source leaves the search for new weaknesses unchanged. Useful practice depends on the agent’s current capabilities, so the procedure that chooses practice must also be revisable. We present RoboACE (Robot Adversarial Co-Evolution), a framework that jointly evolves curriculum and execution harnesses around frozen foundation models. The curriculum harness uses accumulated capability evidence to propose informative challenges, while the execution harness responds with reusable revisions that expand execution capabilities. Alternating updates hold one side fixed as the other changes, and admitted challenges form fixed snapshots for comparing execution revisions. Starting from a compact set of LIBERO practice conditions, the resulting frozen deployment outperforms the evaluated controllers and agent systems across four LIBERO-family panels. On LIBERO-PRO, it reaches 74.0% success, exceeding the initial deployment by 15.0 percentage points and direct execution by its VLA controller by 13.5 points. Case studies document changes to evidence-guided practice selection, drawer-skill grounding, and controller intervention.

Abstract: Vision-Language-Action (VLA) policies are vulnerable to adversarial visual perturbations, while defenses often require task-specific adversarial fine-tuning. We investigate whether robustness learned on source manipulation tasks can protect independently specialized target policies without target-side adversarial training. We first show that even a single source defense update improves robustness on held-out tasks, establishing cross-task defense reuse independently of multi-source aggregation. To combine source updates, we introduce Source-Norm Transferable Robustness Vector (SN-TRV), which retains the direction of their mean while calibrating its magnitude using source-update norms. The resulting update is applied to the target visual encoder without target adversarial data, target-side gradient optimization, or additional inference modules. Evaluations across three VLA backbones, fixed and adaptive attacks, and different source defense recipes show improved robustness over naive averaging and identify limits in attack coverage. Physical PiPER trials increase average success under printed adversarial patches from 20.3% to 45.8%.

Abstract: When a vision-and-language navigation policy generates an action sequence autoregressively, the robot waits for a chain of dependent predictions. A small discrete action vocabulary makes it possible to score all short-horizon plans in parallel. We introduce VLN-Flash, a training-free decoder that evaluates the complete action-prefix tree in a single forward pass. Branch-specific attention and matched token positions preserve the original policy’s conditional action distribution for each prefix in exact arithmetic. We use the score margin between the stepwise-greedy prefix and its strongest alternative at each depth to decide how many actions to execute. The robot then executes the plan with the highest joint score at the chosen depth before observing again. Compared with the native autoregressive decoders, it improves success rate and success weighted by path length (SPL) on R2R-CE and RxR-CE, with success gains up to 2.7 percentage points. On a Unitree GO2, VLN-Flash improves navigation success and cuts the mean wait between actions by about 160 ms after subtracting network transmission time.

Abstract: A surveillance drone on a bandwidth-starved link cannot send the video its operator would need, yet the operator’s questions are often not about pixels: did three people converge, when, and where? We study what should cross a link of 1 Mbps down to 1 kbps instead, and in what order. BPS, a behavior-primitive stream, sends semantics first and pixels later: it runs a detector and a tracker onboard and sends short records (25 bytes on average) of multi-frame events selected by a mission card of 16-125 bytes, ahead of positions and pictures. We measure it by what a ground-side language model answers from it, under a preregistered protocol with a held-out set, against H.265 read by the vision fine-tune of the same model, H.265 on which the ground runs our own perception, a stream of quantized tracks, and onboard captions. On the development set (84% of questions about convergence, mostly one location) the event stream answers 74.3% of questions at 0.13 kbps. A reader that receives nothing answers 57.4%, and the video reader 59.6% at 100 kbps and 64.7% on the source frames. When the ground instead runs our perception on the video, video matches the stream at 100 kbps, about 800 times the stream’s rate, and falls behind at 64 kbps and below. A track stream matches it at 96 times the bytes and loses 0.03 at 17 times. On held-out data the result is weaker: with events taken from annotated tracks, an oracle, the stream beats H.265 at 100 kbps (+0.13), but with onboard perception it does not (+0.01 [-0.04, +0.06]) and is no better than receiving nothing. Sent alone through emulated links the event records answer 0.739 at 1 Mbps and still 0.724 at 0.3 kbps; an every-frame track stream holds down to 1 kbps and video with ground-side perception down to about 100 kbps. On a Jetson Orin Nano the unchanged pipeline runs at 4.5 fps and misses most events.

Abstract: Flow-matching robot policies generate each action chunk through repeated network evaluations, one per denoising step. Cross-cycle caches such as C$^3$ache reuse computation from earlier replanning calls, but whether they beat simply taking fewer steps is unclear. We compare the two in Fast-WAM, a 6B-parameter world action model, on LIBERO-Goal. Two uncached steps keep the success of ten: on all 500 initial states they are non-inferior within two percentage points, for one checkpoint and noise seed. Under PyTorch’s default compile mode, they also cut a replanning call on an RTX A6000 from 202 to 92 ms. This leaves little room for caching. A cache that keeps two fresh steps cannot be faster than two uncached steps: every call still encodes the images, runs the video expert and computes those two steps. Caching the first of two steps, refreshed every fourth call, saves at most 11–14% of a call by our cost model. Cached policies are also fragile. Their losses tracked the share of the flow path the cached steps cover: under Fast-WAM’s current time shift, C$^3$ache’s eight cached steps cover 80% of the path instead of 44%, and the cached policy succeeds on 63% of states against 95% uncached. Resampling the noise on every call cost caches covering 60% or more of the path 14–40 points. These results argue for fewer-step baselines and for testing reuse under the deployed sampler and noise settings. We release our evaluation harness, logs and a checklist.
