Motivation: 针对闭环端到端驾驶在神经重建场景中从零训练成本高、安全与泛化难的问题，论文希望复用成熟的openpilot生产模型，以高效适配方式获得安全可靠的闭环驾驶策略。

Result: 在2026 NVIDIA AlpaSim E2E Driving Challenge中排名第三，超过多数基于基础模型的参赛方案；未进一步训练时在HUGSIM和Odyssey上也处于领先。最终训练仅消耗1 GPU小时，权重相对发布模型仅偏移3.9%。消融显示自校正样本带来主要增益，间隙损失可在无教师处替代。

Insight: 创新在于将量产L2模型迁移到神经重建闭环驾驶：冻结视觉编码器并轻量微调策略层，结合ego-state adapter和route memory；用特权地图教师进行横向自校正、用body-extent损失约束道路与障碍物间隙，并蒸馏基模型输出保留跟车能力；纵向安全则由基模型前车估计加规则速度层保障。

Abstract: We present Lao Siji, an end-to-end driving policy that ranks third in the 2026 NVIDIA AlpaSim E2E Driving Challenge, ahead of most entries built on foundation models. Instead of training from scratch on a general-purpose vision backbone, we adapt openpilot, an open-source L2 production model. We freeze its vision encoder and fine-tune the policy layers with an ego-state adapter and a route memory. On closed-loop rollouts in neural-reconstructed scenes, we supervise the policy with a privileged map teacher for lateral self-correction and a body-extent loss for road and obstacle clearance, while distilling the base model’s remaining outputs to retain car following. Ablations show that self-correction samples carry the gain, while the clearance loss substitutes for them where no teacher exists. Longitudinal safety instead rests on the base model’s lead-vehicle estimate behind a rule-based speed layer. Longer training, imitating human logs, and human-log speed targets yield either no measurable gain or adverse effects. Without further training, Lao Siji also places among the leaders on HUGSIM and Odyssey. The final training takes only one GPU-hour and shifts the weights by 3.9% from the shipped model. Code will be released after review.

[258] PlanDiv: Test-Time Scaling with Latent Plans for Vision-Language-Action Models cs.RO | cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

Hanbo Zhang, Lianlei Shan, Liuhaichen Yang, Zezhi Tang

TL;DR: 论文针对VLA策略测试时缩放中候选动作重采样多样性不足、收益快速衰减的问题，提出PlanDiv动作头：用轻量规划器生成K个潜在计划假设，共享掩码扩散执行器根据每个计划解码动作块，并由策略自身似然选择最优动作块。计划仅从演示中学习，无需计划标签或奖励。在CALVIN、LIBERO-Long和真实Franka上验证了基于计划的候选多样性可提升测试时缩放效果。

Details

Motivation: 现有测试时缩放通过从同一解码器重采样多个动作候选并选最优，但候选间差异主要来自噪声而非不同计划，增加候选数量收益递减。论文希望让候选由不同潜在计划产生，从而提升VLA策略测试时扩展的效率。

Result: 在CALVIN ABC→D五任务链成功率上，8个计划条件候选从56.9%提升到69.9%，高于自回归、无计划或同计划重采样的至多64.9%；LIBERO-Long上4个计划消除40%单候选失败，对照至多21%；真实Franka双臂任务54次试验成功51次，对比OpenVLA-OFT+基线40次，单解任务持平。

Insight: 创新点在于将测试时缩放从动作噪声重采样转为潜在计划假设重采样，并用共享执行器单次骨干前向解码多个计划条件动作块，且计划可从演示中无监督学习。客观看，其价值在于揭示候选多样性应来自高层计划而非低层噪声，并提供无需标签或奖励的计划分解与似然选择机制。

Abstract: Test-time scaling improves vision-language-action (VLA) policies by drawing several action candidates and executing the best one. We find that its returns diminish quickly when the candidates are resampled from one decoder: they differ by noise rather than by plan, and for each of three resampling sources, going from four to eight candidates adds only 0.06-0.07 to the average number of completed tasks on CALVIN. We introduce PlanDiv, an action head that makes the candidates differ by plan: a lightweight planner proposes K latent plan hypotheses, a shared masked-diffusion executor decodes one action chunk per plan from a single backbone pass, and the policy executes the chunk that its own likelihood ranks highest. The plans are learned from demonstrations alone, without plan labels or rewards. With the backbone, data and training recipe held fixed, eight plan-conditioned candidates raise five-task chain success on CALVIN ABC$\rightarrow$D from 56.9% to 69.9%, while eight candidates from autoregressive, plan-free or same-plan resampling reach at most 64.9%. The same-plan baseline is PlanDiv’s own checkpoint with the plan held fixed, so this gap comes from the plans, not from drawing more samples. On LIBERO-Long, four plans remove 40% of single-candidate failures, against at most 21% for matched resampling. On a real Franka arm the gain appears where a task admits more than one solution: PlanDiv is on par with a single-output OpenVLA-OFT+ baseline on a one-solution task and succeeds in 51 of 54 trials against 40 of 54 on two tasks with two solutions.

[259] Prompt Re-Specification and Target-Mask Availability in Mask-Conditioned Visual Reinforcement Learning for Moving-Platform Landing cs.RO | cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

Ho Tim Tsui, Jongyun Kim

TL;DR: 论文研究无人机在移动平台上着陆的视觉强化学习策略对外观变化的鲁棒性问题：以二值目标掩码作为视觉输入（去除像素级外观信息但保留目标空间信息），并用文本提示指定目标。作者在仿真中验证了冻结权重的掩码版DrQ-v2策略仅通过修改其SAM 3检测器的提示词即可适应新外观的着陆垫，并进一步分析了掩码可用性（缺失掩码补全、时序跟踪）对着陆成功率的影响。

Details

Motivation: 视觉RL着陆策略高度依赖训练时着陆垫的外观，一旦测试时着陆垫的颜色或纹理变化就会失效；作者希望用二值掩码剥离外观信息，使策略本身与目标长相解耦，从而以零权重更新的方式适应新的着陆目标。

Result: 在仿真中，香蕉图案着陆垫使成功率从75.6%降至12.0%（原提示下SAM 3几乎检测不到该垫），仅更换提示词、不更新任何权重即恢复至68.4%；另一组用真值掩码训练的策略实验中，补全着陆垫可见期间缺失的掩码带来的提升明显优于掩码质心与面积修正，而时序跟踪虽提供更多掩码，却未带来可靠的成功率提升。

Insight: 论文宣称的创新在于“提示重指定”这一免训练适应手段，以及将失败归因于掩码可用性（可用掩码能否送达策略）而非策略本身。客观来看，其价值更偏向诊断性分析和负结果：提示词靠人工枚举候选选取、实验限于单一仿真场景与单一策略，规模有限，但“用输入抽象+外部检测器提示来换取鲁棒性”的思路以及“先保证掩码可用性再谈策略改进”的结论具有借鉴意义。

Abstract: Visual reinforcement learning (RL) policies that land a drone on a moving platform can fail when the landing pad looks different from the one used in training. Using binary target masks as the visual input removes most pixel-level appearance information while preserving the spatial representation of the target, and lets a text prompt specify the target. In simulation, we test whether a frozen (fixed-weight) mask-based DrQ-v2 policy can handle a new pad when only the prompt of its fine-tuned SAM 3 detector changes. A banana-themed pad lowered landing success from 75.6% to 12.0%, and SAM 3 rarely detected it under the original prompt. A revised prompt, chosen after testing several candidates, restored success to 68.4% with no weight updates. In a separate experiment with a policy trained on ground-truth masks, filling in masks that were missing while the pad was visible helped landing far more than the tested mask-centroid and area corrections. Tracking the pad over time supplied masks more often and also kept producing them after the pad was confirmed absent from the rendered image, but it did not establish a reliable improvement in landing success. Whether a usable mask reaches the policy at all thus appears to be an important limiting factor for this approach.

[260] AsymEEF: Bimanual Manipulation with Asymmetric End Effectors cs.RO | cs.AI | cs.CV | cs.LGPDF

Xiaokang Sun, Ningyue Wang, Kunqi Xu, Guangqi Jiang, Jianglong Ye

TL;DR: AsymEEF 提出一个面向双臂操作的跨末端执行器演示生成与统一策略学习框架。给定少量源数据，它可将演示迁移到二指、三指和五指末端执行器的异构组合，无需额外遥操作，并支持训练统一的双臂视觉运动策略。

Details

Motivation: 遥操作演示采集成本高，且难以在不同运动学和动作空间的末端执行器之间复用；双臂场景中每换一种末端执行器组合往往都需要重新采集数据。

Result: 在四个仿真和六个真实任务上，AsymEEF 的重放成功率优于适配迁移基线，在仿真中取得平均 16.6 倍的重放有效扩展增益，并在真实机器人上通过下游策略训练进行评估。

Insight: 创新点在于用运动学教师锚点提供几何监督、用稀疏真实 X-Calib 锚点校正抓取执行偏差，并通过共享编码器与形态条件解码器实现形态无关表示和跨末端执行器命令重建，同时用重放过滤保证任务级可执行性。

Abstract: Teleoperated demonstrations are costly to collect and rarely reusable across end-effectors with different kinematics and action spaces. This burden grows in bimanual manipulation, where each end-effector pair may require new data. We present AsymEEF, a framework for executable cross-end-effector demonstration generation and unified bimanual policy learning. Given a small source dataset, AsymEEF transfers demonstrations to heterogeneous combinations of two-, three-, and five-fingered end-effectors without additional teleoperation. Kinematic teacher anchors provide geometric supervision, while sparse real-world X-Calib anchors correct discrepancies in grasp execution. A shared encoder maps wrist poses and actuator states to a morphology-agnostic latent space, and a morphology-conditioned decoder reconstructs target commands. Generated trajectories undergo replay filtering for task-level executability. The representation also supports a unified bimanual visuomotor policy trained across multiple pairs. Across four simulated and six real-world tasks, AsymEEF improves replay success over adapted transfer baselines, achieves a mean replay-valid expansion gain of 16.6 times in simulation, and is evaluated through downstream policy training on real robots. Project website: https://asymeef.vercel.app/.

[261] Vision-Language Grounded Semantic Navigation for Autonomous Mobile Robots cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Ravindran Vasoor Saravanan, Chittin Varunav Ravi, Madhumita Singh, Thirulok Sundar Mohan Rasu

TL;DR: 论文提出一个基于ROS2的完整系统，将前沿探索、Grounding DINO开放词汇目标检测、深度3D定位、语义建图和Nav2导航结合，实现仿真环境中的端到端视觉语言接地语义导航。系统接收如“去黄色箱子”的自然语言指令，检测目标并生成导航目标，无需任务特定训练。在Gazebo TurtleBot3室内场景中验证了可行性，但受检测不确定性、定位误差和探索覆盖限制。

Details

Motivation: 解决开放词汇视觉感知与经典机器人建图/导航流程难以集成的问题，使移动机器人能按自然语言在非结构化环境中自主导航到用户指定目标。

Result: 在Gazebo室内环境和TurtleBot3上，系统自主探索房间，检测到5个目标中的3个，并成功执行测试的2条自然语言导航指令，且无需任务特定训练；性能仍受检测不确定性、深度定位误差和探索不完整限制。

Insight: 创新在于将Grounding DINO开放词汇检测、深度3D定位、语义建图、前沿探索与Nav2导航栈集成到ROS2系统，并验证了CPU-only轻量架构下无需任务特定训练的可行性；客观看，更多是系统集成与可行性验证，而非新算法突破。

Abstract: Language-guided navigation enables mobile robots to interpret natural language commands and navigate toward user-specified targets in unstructured environments. However, integrating open-vocabulary visual perception with classical robotics pipelines for mapping and navigation remains a challenging problem. In this work, we present a complete ROS2-based system that combines frontier-based exploration, open-vocabulary object detection using Grounding DINO, depth-based 3D localization, and semantic mapping to enable end-to-end vision-language grounded navigation in simulation. The system accepts natural language commands such as ``go to the yellow box,’’ detects candidate objects from RGB images using text prompts, estimates their positions in the world frame, and generates navigation goals executed by the Nav2 stack. In a Gazebo-based indoor environment with a TurtleBot3 robot, the system autonomously explored the room, detected three of the five target objects, and successfully executed both natural language navigation commands tested, without task-specific training. The results indicate that open-vocabulary grounding models can be integrated into classical navigation pipelines, though performance is limited by detection uncertainty, depth-based localization error, and incomplete exploration coverage. These findings highlight both the feasibility and current limitations of deploying vision-language grounded navigation systems using lightweight, CPU-only architectures.

[262] Selective Sensor Acquisition for Multimodal Place Recognition cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Margaux Edwards, Tobias Fischer, Michael Milford

TL;DR: 论文提出面向多模态地点识别（Place Recognition）的选择性、可控传感器采集机制：用户设定第二传感器的目标使用率，系统仅在主传感器估计性能较差时采集第二传感器，并通过在线阈值调整满足使用率要求。方法只需地点识别方法能输出匹配分数，适用于单帧和序列地点识别。实验表明，在仅25%查询使用第二传感器时可恢复55%的可用性能增益，在50%查询使用时恢复81%。

Details

Motivation: 多模态地点识别虽能提升鲁棒性，但现有系统通常对每个查询都读取并处理所有传感器，即使主传感器已足够，带来能耗、第二传感器更新率及被动隐身等限制。论文希望按需采集额外传感器，把融合计算集中在最可能受益的查询上。

Result: 在多个数据集、地点识别描述符和传感器组合上，方法在第二传感器使用率25%时恢复55%的可用性能增益，在50%时恢复81%。论文还分析了不同采集决策机制、使用率控制方法，以及第二传感器强于、相当于或弱于主传感器时的表现。

Insight: 创新点在于将多模态地点识别的传感器采集转化为可控的使用率约束问题：依据主传感器估计性能触发第二传感器，并通过在线阈值调整适配近期性能，无需针对传感器模态、PR方法或环境校准。客观看，其可借鉴之处是仅依赖匹配分数的通用触发机制和对使用率约束的显式控制，使多模态融合在性能与采集成本之间可调。

Abstract: Multimodal Place Recognition (PR) can improve robustness, but most systems rigidly read and process every sensor for every query, even when the primary sensor is sufficient, with implications for energy consumption, second sensor update rate, and domain-specific considerations such as passive stealth. We introduce selective, controllable sensor acquisition, where a user specifies a desired second sensor usage rate and the system acquires the additional sensor only when the primary sensor’s estimated performance is sufficiently poor. An online threshold adjustment achieves the requested usage rate by adapting to recent primary sensor performance, directing additional sensing towards queries where fusion is most likely to help without calibration specific to sensor modality, PR method, or environment. The approach requires only a PR method that produces a match score and applies to both single-frame and sequence-based PR. Our system, across multiple datasets, PR descriptors, and sensor combinations, recovers 55% of the available PR performance gain while using the second sensor on only 25% of queries, and 81% while using it on 50%. We further analyse alternative acquisition decision mechanisms and usage-rate control methods, and examine performance when the second sensor is stronger than, comparable to, or weaker than the primary sensor.

[263] Robotic Reward Models in the Foundation-Model Era cs.RO | cs.CVPDF

Guoqiang Liang, Yiqi Lin, Shangchen Zhou, Wenzheng Zeng, Yanzhe Chen

TL;DR: 该综述将114种机器人奖励模型（RRM）按原生输出回答的问题分为Outcome、Absolute Progress、Relative、Temporal Value和Hybrid五类，系统梳理模型设计、监督来源与评测实践。作者指出现有评测无法证明奖励是否真正跟踪任务完成，并提出RRM-Bench-1K真实机器人视频基准与RRM-Hub工具库，对27种评测器进行统一研究。

Details

Motivation: 机器人奖励模型试图用基础模型替代逐任务奖励工程，实现可复用、任务条件化的评估；但同名RRM的输出实际回答不同问题，且现有评测多依赖演示顺序一致性或下游策略收益，难以验证奖励是否反映任务完成状态。

Result: 论文构建了包含1,117段真实机器人闭环执行视频的RRM-Bench-1K及四个对比套件，并统一评测27种评测器；结果显示最强最终分数足以用于整体执行排序、筛选，但稠密信用更贴近执行进程而非任务状态，且没有评测器能提示关键视角缺失。

Insight: 主要创新在于按输出语义建立五类RRM分类体系，揭示现有评测与任务完成之间的缺口，并提出带任务状态和相机证据标签的基准与对比套件；其客观启发是奖励模型所需保真度应取决于其驱动的决策，并需发展区分任务状态与时间进程的指标及真实失败监督。

Abstract: Robotic reward models (RRMs) use foundation models to replace per-task reward engineering with reusable, task-conditioned evaluation. Yet under one name, their outputs answer different questions, from whether a task succeeded to which execution is better. This survey organizes 114 methods into five semantic families by the question their native outputs answer: Outcome, Absolute Progress, Relative, Temporal Value, and Hybrid. Within this taxonomy, we review how model design determines what an evaluator can judge, how raw experience becomes supervision, and how existing evaluation practice tests the result. The review exposes a gap: agreement with demonstration order and downstream policy gains do not show whether a reward tracks task fulfillment. We therefore introduce RRM-Bench-1K, 1,117 real-robot videos of closed-loop executions with task-state and camera-evidence labels, and four contrast suites that separate the credited condition from its usual cues. A unified study of 27 evaluators shows that the strongest final scores rank whole executions well enough for selection and filtering. Dense credit, however, follows the progression of an execution more closely than its task state, and no evaluator signals when the decisive view is missing. How much fidelity a reward model needs therefore depends on the decision it drives. We outline directions from real-failure supervision to metrics that separate task state from chronology, and open-source RRM-Hub, a toolbox in which 14 existing RRMs can be readily applied and new evaluators tested on the same capabilities.

cs.SE [Back]

[264] A Survey of Image-to-Code Generation for Software Engineering cs.SE | cs.CVPDF

Licheng Zhang, Xihong Wu, Dingsheng Luo, Siew-Kei Lam

TL;DR: 该论文是一篇关于面向软件工程的图像到代码生成（image-to-code）综述。作者将任务限定为输入包含视觉模态、输出为工程师手工编写的软件代码，涵盖UI/前端代码、UML/流程图恢复代码、视觉驱动的程序修复与测试代码以及通用软件代码。论文提出统一的处理流水线，按视觉理解、组件识别、布局推理、代码规划、代码生成和验证等阶段组织文献，并梳理五个发展阶段、数据集/基准/指标及开放挑战。

Details

Motivation: 软件意图常先以截图、设计稿、UML图、流程图或缺陷图片等视觉形式表达，直接将视觉制品转化为可执行软件是计算机视觉与软件工程交叉的重要问题。现有研究分散，需要一个面向软件工程代码生成的系统化综述来统一任务边界、技术流程和评测资源。

Result: 论文为综述性工作，未提出新方法或报告定量实验结果；其主要结果是提出统一处理流水线、按阶段和任务系统梳理文献，并整合数据集、基准与评价指标，同时总结从规则式逆向工程到智能体生成的五个重叠阶段及开放挑战。

Insight: 创新点在于明确限定软件工程代码这一综述范围并排除图表脚本、矢量图形、硬件描述语言和机器人策略等邻近领域；以“视觉理解—组件识别—布局推理—代码规划—代码生成—验证”的统一流水线组织文献，并归纳设计系统泛化、长程交互生成、跨框架部署、可访问性、幻觉组件和评测不可靠等挑战。

Abstract: A large fraction of software intent is expressed visually before it is implemented. A designer hands a screenshot or a Figma mockup to a front-end engineer, an architect sketches a UML diagram or a flowchart, and a bug report ships with a picture of what went wrong. Turning such visual artifacts directly into executable software has therefore become an active problem at the intersection of computer vision and software engineering. The present survey organizes the literature on image-to-code generation for software engineering, defined as the family of methods whose input contains a visual modality and whose output is software an engineer would otherwise write by hand. We deliberately scope the survey to software-engineering code, namely user-interface and front-end code, code recovered from software diagrams such as UML and flowcharts, program repair and test code driven by visual signals, and general software-code targets, and we exclude adjacent code-generation domains whose home communities lie elsewhere, such as chart plotting scripts, vector-graphics programs, hardware description languages, and robot policies. Rather than cataloguing systems in isolation, we introduce a unified processing pipeline of visual understanding, component recognition, layout reasoning, code planning, code generation, and verification, and organize the survey around its stages. We trace five overlapping eras from rule-based reverse engineering to agentic generation, survey each pipeline stage and each software-engineering task in depth grounded in what individual systems actually do, consolidate the datasets, benchmarks, and metrics, and lay out the open challenges of design-system generalization, long-horizon and interactive generation, cross-framework deployment, accessibility, hallucinated components, and unreliable evaluation.

[265] AuXSpec: Learning to Autoformalize Program Specifications via Executable Postconditions cs.SE | cs.CLPDF

Haocheng Wang, Weixuan Yuan, Florian Hübler, Yinya Huang, Zhijiang Guo

TL;DR: 论文提出 AuXSpec，一个基于 Lean 的自动形式化框架：将声明式后置条件与可执行版本配对，用测试用例执行结果是否一致作为强化学习奖励，从而训练程序规约生成模型。作者基于 LeetCode 合成 3,037 道题，并通过 Codeforces 上的专家迭代扩展到 19.5K 样本。实验表明该方法显著提升 Qwen 模型生成规约的 pass@4，并在域外 Verina 基准上超过开源 SOTA。

Details

Motivation: 形式化规约对程序验证至关重要，但用 Lean 等定理证明器手写规约耗时且依赖专家，成为形式正确代码规模化的瓶颈。现有自动形式化训练缺乏可扩展反馈来判断生成规约是否真正刻画程序行为，而依赖显式证明或带形式对应证明的独立实现成本很高。

Result: 在 AuXSpec-Test 上，Qwen3.5-9B 和 Qwen3.8-27B 的 SpecGen pass@4 分别从 0.7% 提升到 82.7%、从 14.3% 提升到 84.3%，27B 模型优于所有前沿模型。在 Verina 原始提示的域外评测中，两者分别从 7.0%、21.9% 提升到 90.5%，并在 pass@1 和 pass@4 上超过此前开源规约模型 SOTA VeriSpecGen-30B-A3B。

Insight: 核心创新是用“声明式后置条件 + 可执行对应物”的可执行一致性作为可扩展奖励信号，避免训练时依赖昂贵证明，并结合类型类解析、等价性证明、测试执行和专家迭代构建数据闭环。客观来看，其贡献还包括可复用的合成数据、专家审核基准和模型权重，推动了自动形式化训练与评测基础设施建设。

Abstract: Formal specifications define intended program behavior and underpin verification, but writing them in theorem provers such as Lean is slow and expertise-intensive, making specification a major bottleneck to scaling formally correct code. Autoformalization from natural-language problems is promising, yet training specification models requires scalable feedback on whether generated specifications capture intended behavior. Prior approaches obtain this feedback through explicit proofs or separately implemented code with formal correspondence proofs, both expensive. We introduce AuXSpec, a Lean framework that pairs declarative postconditions with executable counterparts, obtained through type class resolution when possible and otherwise defined separately with an equivalence proof. Test cases can then evaluate declarative specifications by execution, letting us use agreement as a reinforcement-learning reward. Using AuXSpec, we synthesize 3,037 LeetCode problems and expand training to 19.5K samples through expert iteration on Codeforces. Experiments show that training Qwen3.5-9B and Qwen3.8-27B with the execution-based reward improves SpecGen pass@4 on AuXSpec-Test 0.7% $\to$ 82.7% and 14.3% $\to$ 84.3%, and the 27B model outperforms all frontier models. On the out-of-domain Verina benchmark with its original prompts, both models improve 7.0% $\to$ 90.5% and 21.9% $\to$ 90.5% and surpass VeriSpecGen-30B-A3B, the prior state of the art among open-source specification models, on pass@1 (theirs 47.6% vs. ours 73.7% and 84.5%) and pass@4 (theirs 63.9% at pass@10 vs. ours 90.5%). We release the weights of the trained 9B and 27B models and the 3,037 problems with test cases, including the 300-problem AuXSpec-Test benchmark with expert review and correctness proofs for future evaluation. Models and data: https://huggingface.co/collections/eth-algopt/auxspec. Website: https://auxspec.org

[266] XLSAR-Bench: Towards Extremely Large SAR Imagery Understanding of MLLMs eess.IV | cs.CVPDF

La Jiang, Lingfeng Chen, Jiaqi Zhu, Fengrong Guo, Jiehua Zhang

TL;DR: 论文提出XLSAR-Bench，一个面向多模态大语言模型（MLLMs）的超大场景SAR影像理解综合基准。该基准包含405张平均7153×7153像素的SAR图像，覆盖视觉问答、视觉定位和详细图像描述等10项任务，样本经人工标注并辅以半自动描述器。实验评估通用与领域专用MLLM，揭示其在大场景SAR理解和细小目标感知上的持续挑战。

Details

Motivation: 现有SAR基准多基于小图像块，难以同时评估完整大场景所需的全局语义解释和细粒度目标感知能力；因此需要面向大尺寸SAR场景的综合基准来检验MLLM的能力与局限。

Result: 在XLSAR-Bench上的实验表明，通用和领域特定MLLM在大场景SAR理解及小目标准确感知方面仍存在明显挑战；摘要未给出具体数值或SOTA结论。

Insight: 创新点在于构建大尺寸、多任务、人工精细标注的SAR MLLM基准，联合考察全局场景理解与细粒度目标感知。客观看，其价值主要是填补大场景SAR评测空白，并暴露现有MLLM在遥感小目标和大图理解上的短板。

Abstract: The rapid development of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) has highlighted the need for comprehensive benchmarks to assess their capabilities and limitations in remote sensing (RS). However, evaluating MLLMs in large-size synthetic aperture radar (SAR) scenarios remains challenging, as understanding complete scenes requires both global semantic interpretation and fine-grained target perception. Existing SAR benchmarks predominantly rely on small image patches, limiting their ability to assess these capabilities jointly. To address these limitations, we present XLSAR-Bench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating the perception and reasoning capabilities of MLLMs in large-scene SAR imagery. XLSAR-Bench comprises 405 images with an average size of 7153$\times$7153 pixels, ten tasks spanning visual question answering, visual grounding, and detailed image captioning, with all evaluation samples meticulously annotated manually, assisted by a semi-automatic captioner. Experimental results from general-purpose and domain-specific MLLMs reveal persistent challenges in understanding large SAR scenes and accurately perceiving small targets. We have open-sourced XLSAR-Bench to support further research in developing more powerful MLLMs for complete large SAR scenes.

[267] Streaming across viewing conditions - The effect of viewing distance and display luminance on video quality eess.IV | cs.CV | cs.MMPDF

Dounia Hammou, Lukáš Krasula, Christos G. Bampis, Zhi Li, Rafał K. Mantiuk

TL;DR: 论文研究观看距离和显示亮度对流媒体视频质量失真的影响，指出多数质量指标假设固定最优观看条件。作者构建了4K HDR流媒体失真数据集HDR-VDC，并提出基于显示模型、PU21感知均匀编码和透视投影缩放PPS的预处理框架，使现有质量指标可适配不同观看距离与亮度条件，并比较了35个SOTA指标。

Details

Motivation: 流媒体视频失真可见性会随显示亮度和观看距离变化，但大多数图像/视频质量指标假设固定最优显示与观看条件，因此对真实观看环境不敏感，评估可能失真。

Result: 论文采集了HDR-VDC数据集，包含12个4K和4个FHD HDR源视频，施加AV1编码和Lanczos上采样失真，并在60/120 ppd两种观看距离及亮度相差8倍的两档显示亮度下测质量损失；用所提框架比较35个SOTA指标，筛选出可有效适配观看条件的现有质量指标。摘要未给出具体数值或明确SOTA结论。

Insight: 创新点在于用显示模型与PU21感知均匀编码建模亮度影响、用透视投影缩放PPS建模观看距离影响，从而统一适配多种现有质量指标；同时提供覆盖HDR、4K流媒体失真及观看条件变化的视频质量数据集，具有可借鉴的评测与预处理思路。

Abstract: The visibility of streamed video distortions is affected by the user’s display and viewing conditions, such as their display’s luminance or the viewing distance. Distortions become less visible at lower luminance levels or farther viewing distances. However, most image and video quality metrics assume fixed optimal display and viewing conditions, making them insensitive to the viewing conditions. In this work, we demonstrate how existing metrics can be adapted to account for both factors and compare such an adaptation with the metrics that natively model viewing conditions. First, we collected a new video quality dataset, HDR-VDC, which contains streaming distortions in 4K HDR videos. The dataset consists of 12 4K and 4 FHD HDR source video content, each distorted with AV1 encoding and Lanczos upscaling from a lower resolution. The quality loss due to the distortions was measured at two viewing distances, corresponding to 60 and 120 pixels per visual degree, and two display mean luminance levels, varying by a factor of 8 in terms of luminance. Next, we developed a pre-processing framework that lets us adapt many quality metrics so that they can evaluate content across the viewing distances and luminance levels. The framework employs a display model and perceptually uniform encoding, PU21, to account for the effect of display luminance, and perspective projection scaling (PPS) to account for the effect of viewing distance. We used the framework to compare the performance of 35 state-of-the-art metrics. This allowed us to identify a selection of existing quality metrics that can be effectively adapted to account for the viewing conditions.

[268] Scribble Once, Segment the Sequence: Bidirectional Temporal Consistency for Weakly Supervised Segmentation in Echocardiography Sequences eess.IV | cs.CVPDF

Vincent Li Weixin, Chen Jingkun, Vicente Grau

TL;DR: 论文提出一种用于超声心动图序列的弱监督时序分割框架，仅需对序列中单帧进行涂鸦标注，其余帧均不标注。方法在mean-teacher架构中参数高效地适配DINOv3编码器，并结合包括时序损失在内的互补损失，为无标注帧生成可靠分割先验，从而实现从极稀疏监督到整段序列的分割。

Details

Motivation: 时序医学图像分割依赖逐像素标注，长序列标注成本极高；现有弱监督方法虽减少单帧标注量，但仍需跨序列重复标注，且稀疏监督容易导致时序表示不稳定。

Result: 在公开的CAMUS和CardiacNet数据集上，该方法优于其他涂鸦监督分割方法，表明仅凭极稀疏监督即可获得准确且时序一致的分割结果，显著降低时序超声心动图分割的标注需求。

Insight: 创新点在于将单帧涂鸦监督与冻结2D视觉基础模型的可迁移空间先验结合，通过参数高效适配和mean-teacher时序传播，并用互补损失（含时序损失）解耦标注成本与序列长度；客观看，其可借鉴之处是利用大规模预训练空间表征弥补弱监督时序模型的不稳定性。

Abstract: Temporal medical image segmentation relies on pixel-wise annotations, which are prohibitively expensive for long image sequences. Existing weakly-supervised methods reduce the annotation burden per frame but still require repeated annotations across the sequence. Furthermore, sparse supervision can result in temporally unstable representations. Addressing both challenges requires a model that can leverage strong spatial priors from large-scale pretraining while minimizing reliance on dense annotations. Frozen 2D vision foundation models provide a promising basis for this by offering transferable spatial representations with low trainable parameters. However, their lack of explicit temporal modeling limits their ability to propagate reliable information across anatomical sequences. To address this, we present a weakly-supervised framework for temporal segmentation from a single scribble-annotated frame, with all remaining frames left unlabeled. The framework combines parameter-efficient adaptation of DINOv3 encoders present in the mean-teacher architecture. Furthermore, a set of complementary losses, including a temporal loss helps generate reliable segmentation priors for the unlabeled frames. This formulation decouples annotation costs from sequence length while retaining the transferable spatial knowledge of the pretrained encoder. Extensive experiments on the publicly available CAMUS and CardiacNet datasets demonstrate that our approach outperforms other scribble-supervised methods. These results show that accurate and temporally consistent segmentation can be achieved from extremely sparse supervision, substantially reducing annotation requirements for temporal echocardiographic segmentation and providing a practical framework for scalable clinical deployment.

[269] MolReps: Taking SELFIES, Making SMILES, Teaching LLMs physics.chem-ph | cs.AI | cs.CLPDF

Ken Deng, Garrett Morris

TL;DR: 论文研究大语言模型能否识别同一分子的多种等价表示，并提出MolReps流水线，生成覆盖10种分子表示、共9600个问答对的数据，用于转换、归一化和2D结构识别任务。对纯文本和多模态分子LLM进行后训练后，模型在分子重叠测试集上的表示转换与匹配能力大幅提升，并在MolRepBench的分子性质预测上取得相对基模型平均27.84%的提升；但在分子不相交测试集上仍存在明显泛化差距。

Details

Motivation: 同一分子可用SMILES、SELFIES、InChIKey等多种语法不同的表示表达，但LLM是否能理解这些表示之间的等价关系尚不明确。论文旨在通过针对性数据构造和后训练，提升模型对分子表示的理解、转换和归一化能力，并探索其对下游分子任务的帮助。

Result: 在分子重叠测试集上，MQ3-4B-I和MQ3-VL-4B-I的InChIKey匹配率分别从4.01%提升到75.13%、从7.11%提升到73.14%。在分子不相交测试集上，生成有效性分别从20.35%提升到58.12%、从17.19%提升到59.34%，但InChIKey匹配率仍较低且有所下降；在MolRepBench上，所得模型相对基模型平均提升27.84%。

Insight: 论文的创新点在于构建覆盖10种分子表示的统一QA数据流水线，并系统评估LLM对分子表示等价性的理解及分子不相交条件下的泛化能力。客观来看，其可借鉴之处是将分子表示转换、归一化和2D结构识别统一为后训练任务，同时揭示了重叠测试集性能提升与真实泛化能力之间仍存在差距。

Abstract: The same molecule can be expressed in multiple, syntactically distinct representations, yet it remains unclear whether large language models (LLMs) can recognize and relate these equivalent encodings. We introduce MolReps, a pipeline that generates 9,600 question-answer pairs across ten representations for conversion, normalization, and 2D structure recognition. Post-training on MolReps improves text-only and multimodal models, MolQwen3-4B-Instruct (MQ3-4B-I) and MolQwen3-VL-4B-Instruct (MQ3-VL-4B-I), from $4.01%$ to $75.13%$ and from $7.11%$ to $73.14%$ (InChIKey match) on the molecule-overlap test set, respectively. On the molecule-disjoint test set, post-training increased validity from $20.35%$ to $58.12%$ for MQ3-4B-I and from $17.19%$ to $59.34%$ for MQ3-VL-4B-I. However, InChIKey match remained low, decreasing from $3.86%$ to $3.09%$ and from $6.44%$ to $2.29%$, respectively. Furthermore, the resulting models achieve a relative $27.84%$ improvement in average over their base model on MolRepBench, a comprehensive benchmark for evaluating molecular property prediction. These results show the effectiveness of targeted post-training for enhancing molecular representation understanding and its potential to improve downstream molecular tasks.
